title: Non-intrusive surrogate modelling using sparse random features with applications in crashworthiness analysis
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于稀疏随机特征的代理模型方法，可应用于碰撞安全性分析中的不确定性量化，其方法有潜力迁移到生物力学植入物设计中的昂贵仿真替代。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, contact mechanics, or patient-specific design; it focuses on crashworthiness analysis without biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效代理模型是数据驱动不确定性量化的关键需求。
summary_zh.method: 提出结合自监督降维的稀疏随机特征代理建模方法。
summary_zh.result: 在合成数据和碰撞安全性分析数据上优于多项式混沌展开和神经网络。
summary_zh.validation: 通过合成数据和真实碰撞仿真数据验证。

summary_en.motivation: Efficient surrogate modelling is essential for uncertainty quantification in data-driven engineering scenarios.
summary_en.method: A novel non-intrusive surrogate modelling approach using sparse random features combined with self-supervised dimensionality reduction is proposed.
summary_en.result: The proposed method outperforms polynomial chaos expansions and neural networks on both synthetic and real crashworthiness analysis data.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on synthetic benchmarks and real crashworthiness simulation datasets.

title: Flexural mechanical properties of Ti-6Al-4V multilayer micro-lattice biomaterials for skull repair
first_author_affiliation: Center for Composite Materials and Structures, Harbin Institute of Technology, Harbin 150001, PR China

corresponding_authors.name: Qianqian Wu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Center for Composite Materials and Structures, Harbin Institute of Technology, Harbin 150001, PR China

corresponding_authors.name: Linzhi Wu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Center for Composite Materials and Structures, Harbin Institute of Technology, Harbin 150001, PR China

relevance_to_user: 论文研究了Ti-6Al-4V多层微晶格结构用于颅骨修复的弯曲力学性能，直接涉及增材制造生物医学材料，但未涉及应力遮挡、疲劳或骨整合。
why_not_core: Does not address fatigue behavior, stress shielding, or osseointegration, and the application is skull repair rather than hip implant.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估Ti-6Al-4V多层微晶格结构用于颅骨修复的弯曲力学性能。
summary_zh.method: 通过激光粉末床熔融制造多层微晶格，并进行三点弯曲测试。
summary_zh.result: 获得了晶格结构的弯曲刚度和强度，并分析了层数影响。
summary_zh.validation: 对制造的试样进行力学测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the flexural mechanical properties of Ti-6Al-4V multilayer micro-lattice structures for potential skull repair applications.
summary_en.method: Multilayer micro-lattice samples were fabricated via laser powder bed fusion and tested under three-point bending.
summary_en.result: The bending stiffness and strength of the lattice structures were quantified, with analysis of layer number effects.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through mechanical testing of fabricated specimens.

title: A projection-based reduced-order model for parametric quasi-static nonlinear mechanics using an open-source industrial code
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种针对参数化准静态非线性力学的投影降阶方法，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计的快速仿真。
why_not_core: This paper does not include uncertainty quantification, constraint handling, or implant/biomechanics-specific applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低参数化非线性力学仿真中高保真模型的计算成本
summary_zh.method: 基于POD-Greedy自适应算法和单元经验求积的超缩减策略构建降阶模型
summary_zh.result: 在三维弹塑性系统上验证了方法的准确性和效率
summary_zh.validation: 通过三维弹塑性数值算例验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of high-fidelity simulations in parametric quasi-static nonlinear mechanics for engineering studies.
summary_en.method: A projection-based reduced-order model using POD-Greedy adaptive algorithm and element-wise empirical quadrature hyper-reduction integrated into the industrial FE code code aster.
summary_en.result: The method is validated on a 3D elastoplastic system, demonstrating accuracy and computational savings.
summary_en.validation: Numerical simulation of a 3D elastoplastic system.

title: In-situ tailoring mechanical properties of metastable Ti15Mo alloy produced by selective laser melting
first_author_affiliation: HuBei Engineering Institute, Huangshi, 435003, China

corresponding_authors.name: Anping Dong
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Shanghai Key Laboratory of Advanced High-temperature Materials and Precision Forming, School of Materials Science and Engineering, Shanghai JiaoTong University, Shanghai, 200240, China

corresponding_authors.name: Hui Xing
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Shanghai Key Laboratory of Advanced High-temperature Materials and Precision Forming, School of Materials Science and Engineering, Shanghai JiaoTong University, Shanghai, 200240, China

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究SLM制备Ti15Mo合金的力学性能调控，未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳测试，与生物医用植入物方向的直接相关性有限。
why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structure design for stress shielding reduction, does not include fatigue testing, and lacks surface roughness or osseointegration evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过SLM工艺优化调控亚稳态Ti15Mo合金的力学性能
summary_zh.method: 调整激光功率、扫描速度等参数实现组织与性能优化
summary_zh.result: 获得了不同相组成与力学性能的Ti15Mo合金试样
summary_zh.validation: 室温拉伸和显微硬度测试验证力学性能变化

summary_en.motivation: To tailor the mechanical properties of metastable Ti15Mo alloy by adjusting selective laser melting parameters for potential biomedical applications.
summary_en.method: Variation of SLM process parameters to control phase composition and microstructure evolution.
summary_en.result: Different mechanical properties were achieved through parameter-induced phase transformation and grain refinement.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing including tensile tests and microhardness measurements were performed to characterize the resulting properties.

title: Gaussian Process Priors for Systems of Linear Partial Differential Equations with Constant Coefficients
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种将线性PDE系统嵌入高斯过程先验的方法，可迁移至生物力学FEA替代建模，但未涉及约束处理或UQ。
why_not_core: No constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification beyond point prediction, and no demonstration on implant or biomechanics problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 将线性PDE系统嵌入机器学习模型以融入物理知识
summary_zh.method: 基于Ehrenpreis-Palamodov原理构造GP核，使所有实现精确满足PDE
summary_zh.result: 在热方程、波动方程和麦克斯韦方程上计算时间和精度均优于现有方法
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试，与解析解或数值解对比

summary_en.motivation: To incorporate physical knowledge into machine learning by embedding linear PDE systems into Gaussian process priors.
summary_en.method: Construct GP kernels via the Ehrenpreis-Palamodov fundamental principle, ensuring all realizations exactly satisfy the given linear PDE system.
summary_en.result: Achieves superior computation time and precision on heat, wave, and Maxwell equations, often by orders of magnitude.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks comparing against analytical or numerical solutions.

title: Characteristics-Informed Neural Networks for Forward and Inverse Hyperbolic Problems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的特征信息神经网络（CINN）可高效求解双曲型PDE，其方法有望迁移至生物力学中的波动或对流主导问题，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on hyperbolic PDEs (advection, acoustics) and does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant mechanics, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决双曲型PDE求解中PINN训练慢、易产生非物理解的难题
summary_zh.method: 在神经网络中加入特征层，编码PDE特征，仅用数据拟合损失训练
summary_zh.result: CINN在精度和训练速度上均优于PINN，且自动满足PDE
summary_zh.validation: 通过平流方程、刚性周期平流方程和声学问题数值验证

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the slow training and non-physical solutions of PINNs for hyperbolic PDEs by embedding characteristic information into the network architecture.
summary_en.method: A characteristic layer is added to a deep neural network, encoding the PDE's characteristics, and the network is trained solely with a data-fitting MSE loss without residual collocation points.
summary_en.result: CINN achieves higher accuracy and faster training than baseline PINN on advection and acoustics problems, automatically satisfying the PDE even at initialization.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on the advection equation, stiff periodic advection, and an acoustics problem demonstrate improved accuracy and training efficiency.

title: A Learning-Based Optimal Uncertainty Quantification Method and Its Application to Ballistic Impact Problems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的基于学习的优化不确定性量化方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的代理模型与约束优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for biomedical implants, nor does it handle multi-objective constraints or biomechanics-specific design.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决输入概率测度部分已知时系统输出不确定性的最优边界计算难题
summary_zh.method: 使用深度神经网络分类器近似性能指标，结合随机梯度下降求解约束优化问题
summary_zh.result: 在镁合金冲击问题上验证了方法有效性，可构建工程安全设计图谱
summary_zh.validation: 通过镁合金冲击仿真案例验证了学习框架的可行性

summary_en.motivation: To compute optimal uncertainty bounds for systems with partially known input probability measures, which is a high-dimensional non-convex optimization problem.
summary_en.method: A neural network classifier approximates the performance indicator, and stochastic gradient descent solves the resulting constraint optimization.
summary_en.result: The learning-based framework successfully quantifies uncertainty in magnesium alloy impact problems and enables performance certification maps.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on a ballistic impact simulation case of magnesium alloys.

title: Physics informed neural networks for elliptic equations with oscillatory differential operators
relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了PINN在多尺度椭圆方程中的训练困难，其NTK分析方法和多尺度处理思路可迁移至生物力学FEA代理模型中的高频振荡问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant/biomechanics design, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification; it focuses on a pure PDE analysis without any biomedical or engineering application context.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准PINN求解多尺度椭圆方程时训练困难，需解释原因。
summary_zh.method: 通过分析神经正切核矩阵的Frobenius范数随尺度参数ε的变化，揭示训练刚度。
summary_zh.result: NTK范数以1/ε²增长，导致梯度下降训练困难。
summary_zh.validation: 数值算例验证了优化问题的刚度。

summary_en.motivation: Standard PINNs struggle to solve elliptic PDEs with oscillatory coefficients, and the underlying cause of this difficulty is not well understood.
summary_en.method: The Frobenius norm of the neural tangent kernel matrix is analyzed as a function of the scale parameter ε to quantify training stiffness.
summary_en.result: The NTK norm grows as 1/ε², making gradient-based optimization increasingly difficult as scale separation increases.
summary_en.validation: Numerical examples demonstrate the stiffness of the optimization problem for multiscale coefficients.

title: Improving Uncertainty Quantification of Variance Networks by Tree-Structured Learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的树结构方差网络方法可迁移用于生物力学代理模型的不确定性量化，但未涉及有限元或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No FEA validation, no biomedical context, no implant mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升方差网络的不确定性量化能力
summary_zh.method: 提出基于树结构划分特征空间的局部神经网络模型
summary_zh.result: 在UCI数据集上优于现有方法
summary_zh.validation: 在多个UCI基准数据集上验证

summary_en.motivation: To improve uncertainty quantification in variance networks by capturing heterogeneity in prediction uncertainty.
summary_en.method: Proposes a tree-structured neural regression tree that partitions feature space into regions with distinct uncertainty, training region-specific networks for mean and variance.
summary_en.result: Outperforms recent variance-based uncertainty quantification methods on extensive UCI datasets.
summary_en.validation: Validated on multiple UCI benchmark datasets with statistical comparisons.

title: Parameter Inference based on Gaussian Processes Informed by Nonlinear Partial Differential Equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的PIGP方法可用于非线性PDE参数推断，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模中的参数估计问题。
why_not_core: The paper does not address implant design, biomechanics, or multi-objective constrained optimization; it focuses on PDE parameter inference without surrogate modeling for expensive simulations.

summary_zh.motivation: 避免传统PDE参数推断中大量数值求解的计算开销
summary_zh.method: 将PDE解建模为高斯过程，通过流形约束满足线性PDE，并扩展至非线性PDE
summary_zh.result: 方法可处理多维PDE系统，提供参数和解的UQ，完全绕过数值求解器
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个不同领域的数值算例验证

summary_en.motivation: To avoid the computational burden of repeatedly solving PDEs numerically for parameter inference.
summary_en.method: Model the PDE solution as a Gaussian process and enforce PDE constraints via manifold constraints, with an augmentation method for nonlinear PDEs.
summary_en.result: The method handles multi-dimensional PDE systems, provides uncertainty quantification for parameters and solution, and bypasses numerical solvers.
summary_en.validation: Demonstrated on several numerical examples from different domains.

title: Real-time Health Monitoring of Heat Exchangers using Hypernetworks and PINNs
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的超网络PINN方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型，但未涉及植入物设计或约束优化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or multi-objective constrained optimization; it focuses on heat exchanger health monitoring.

summary_zh.motivation: 实现换热器实时健康监测，避免重新训练PINN。
summary_zh.method: 采用超网络实现域分解PINN，动态边界条件下快速推理。
summary_zh.result: 推理速度提升数个数量级，精度与物理仿真相当。
summary_zh.validation: 与基于物理的仿真结果对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To enable real-time health monitoring of heat exchangers without retraining PINNs under varying boundary conditions.
summary_en.method: A hypernetwork-based approach is used to train a domain-decomposed PINN that adapts to dynamic boundary conditions, achieving fast inference.
summary_en.result: Inference time is reduced by orders of magnitude while maintaining accuracy comparable to physics-based simulations.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed by comparing the PINN predictions with physics-based simulation results.

title: MICROSTRUCTURAL AND MICROMECHANICAL TESTSOF TITANIUM CROWNS
first_author_affiliation: Jagiellonian University Medical College, Faculty of Medicine, Dental Institute, Department of Dental Prosthodontics and Orthodontics

corresponding_authors.name: Wojciech Ryniewicz
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Jagiellonian University Medical College, Faculty of Medicine, Dental Institute, Department of Dental Prosthodontics and Orthodontics

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及SLM制备钛合金牙冠的力学性能，但未涉及多孔结构、疲劳或应力屏蔽，与用户方向相关性有限。
why_not_core: No porous structure design, no fatigue testing, no osseointegration assessment, no stress shielding analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较SLM和CAD/CAM技术对钛合金牙冠显微结构和力学性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 对Ti6Al4V牙冠进行显微组织观察、显微硬度测试和内部形状精度分析。
summary_zh.result: SLM牙冠显微硬度更高，但两种技术的形状精度相当。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测试验证显微硬度及结构精度。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the impact of manufacturing technology (SLM vs. CAD/CAM milling) on the microstructure and micromechanical properties of titanium dental crowns.
summary_en.method: Microstructure examination, microhardness testing, and internal shape accuracy analysis were performed on Ti6Al4V crowns produced by both methods.
summary_en.result: SLM crowns exhibited higher microhardness, while shape accuracy was comparable between the two technologies.
summary_en.validation: Experimental characterization via microscopy and microhardness testing.

title: Physics-informed Neural Networks with Periodic Activation Functions for Solute Transport in Heterogeneous Porous Media
relevance_to_user: 该论文使用物理信息神经网络求解多孔介质中的溶质输运问题，其方法可迁移至生物力学中的代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or uncertainty quantification; it focuses on solute transport in porous media.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速非均质多孔介质中溶质输运的模拟。
summary_zh.method: 采用周期激活函数的物理信息神经网络求解对流-弥散方程。
summary_zh.result: sin激活函数比tanh精度高两个数量级，推理时间比FEM快三个数量级。
summary_zh.validation: 与解析解或数值解对比绝对点误差和均方误差。

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate solute transport simulation in heterogeneous porous media by overcoming the computational burden of high-resolution meshing.
summary_en.method: Physics-informed Neural Networks with periodic activation functions (sin) are employed to solve the advection-dispersion equation in a mesh-free manner.
summary_en.result: The sin activation function achieves up to two orders of magnitude higher accuracy and two times faster training than tanh, and reduces inference time by three orders of magnitude compared to FEM.
summary_en.validation: Accuracy is validated by comparing absolute point error and mean square error against analytical or numerical ground truth solutions.

title: Neural-Network-Augmented Projection-Based Model Order Reduction for Mitigating the Kolmogorov Barrier to Reducibility of CFD Models
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的PROM-ANN方法可缓解对流主导流动的降阶瓶颈，其思路可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及约束处理、不确定性量化或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on CFD for shock-dominated flows, not on FEA surrogate modeling for implant biomechanics, and lacks constraint handling, UQ, or biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 克服对流主导流动中降阶模型的科尔莫戈罗夫屏障
summary_zh.method: 结合投影降阶模型与人工神经网络构建非线性近似流形
summary_zh.result: 在激波主导基准问题上展示了降维和超缩减的可行性
summary_zh.validation: 通过参数化激波主导基准问题进行数值验证

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the Kolmogorov barrier in reduced-order modeling of convection-dominated flows by combining projection-based ROM with neural networks.
summary_en.method: A PROM-ANN framework that uses a quadratic approximation manifold and ANN to achieve nonlinear dimensionality reduction without high-dimensional training data.
summary_en.result: The method demonstrates effective dimensionality reduction and hyperreduction on a parametric shock-dominated benchmark problem.
summary_en.validation: Numerical validation on a benchmark problem with shock-dominated features.

title: A certified wavelet-based physics-informed neural network for the solution of parameterized partial differential equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于小波的PINN方法，并提供了可计算的误差上界，对于参数化PDE的模型降阶具有潜在价值，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant or biomechanics design, lacks experimental validation, and focuses on elliptic PDEs without considering constraints or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 为参数化PDE的PINN提供可计算的误差上界，提升模型降阶的可靠性。
summary_zh.method: 使用自适应小波展开的残差加权和作为损失函数和误差界。
summary_zh.result: 数值实验表明小波误差界具有良好的定量有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过椭圆型PDE的数值算例验证误差界的有效性。

summary_en.motivation: To construct PINNs with a computable error bound for reliable model reduction of parameterized PDEs.
summary_en.method: A weighted sum of adaptive wavelet expansion coefficients of the residual is used for both the loss function and an error bound.
summary_en.result: Numerical examples demonstrate good quantitative effectivity of the wavelet-based error bound.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on elliptic PDEs using both variational and ultra-weak formulations.

title: Neuroevolution of Physics-Informed Neural Nets: Benchmark Problems and Comparative Results
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出用神经进化算法替代梯度下降训练PINN，可提高全局搜索能力，对解决FEA替代模型中的优化问题有借鉴意义。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to biomedical or implant design problems, lacks uncertainty quantification, and does not address multi-objective or constrained optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: PINN训练中梯度下降易陷入局部最优，需要全局搜索方法。
summary_zh.method: 提出五个PINN基准问题，比较神经进化与梯度下降算法。
summary_zh.result: 神经进化算法在物理一致性上优于梯度下降。
summary_zh.validation: 在五个不同物理现象的基准问题上进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Physics-informed neural networks suffer from rugged loss landscapes where gradient descent often converges to spurious local minima, motivating the need for global optimization methods.
summary_en.method: Five benchmark problems spanning diverse physical phenomena are proposed, and two neuroevolution algorithms are compared against stochastic gradient descent for training PINNs.
summary_en.result: Neuroevolution algorithms achieve better physics compliance in predicted outputs compared to gradient descent.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on the five benchmark problems demonstrate the superiority of neuroevolution over gradient descent.

title: Bayesian posterior approximation with stochastic ensembles
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的随机集成贝叶斯后验近似方法可迁移至代理模型的不确定性量化，但未涉及有限元或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or implant/biomechanics design; it focuses on Bayesian inference for image classification.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高贝叶斯后验近似的准确性，解决深度集成与随机方法的结合问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出随机集成神经网络，结合MC dropout与变分推断近似后验。
summary_zh.result: 在玩具问题和CIFAR分类上，随机集成比基线方法更接近HMC后验。
summary_zh.validation: 与哈密顿蒙特卡洛模拟对比验证后验质量。

summary_en.motivation: To improve Bayesian posterior approximation by combining stochastic neural networks with deep ensembles.
summary_en.method: Proposes stochastic ensembles as families of distributions trained via variational inference, integrating MC dropout, DropConnect, and a novel non-parametric dropout.
summary_en.result: Stochastic ensembles yield more accurate posterior estimates than popular baselines on a toy problem and CIFAR classification, validated against Hamiltonian Monte Carlo.
summary_en.validation: Posterior quality is validated by direct comparison with Hamiltonian Monte Carlo simulations.

title: Post-hoc Uncertainty Learning using a Dirichlet Meta-Model
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种后验不确定性量化方法，可迁移至代理模型以提升预测可靠性，但未涉及有限元或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or implant/biomechanics design; it focuses on image classification uncertainty.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有不确定性量化方法需重新训练模型，计算成本高。
summary_zh.method: 提出一种基于狄利克雷元模型的后验不确定性学习方法。
summary_zh.result: 在图像分类基准上有效提升不确定性估计性能。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个图像分类数据集上验证了方法的灵活性和优越性。

summary_en.motivation: Existing uncertainty quantification methods require retraining the entire model, which is computationally expensive and often infeasible.
summary_en.method: A Bayesian meta-model based on Dirichlet distribution is proposed to augment pre-trained models with uncertainty quantification in a post-hoc manner.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves superior performance on out-of-domain detection, misclassification detection, and trustworthy transfer learning benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Empirical validation is conducted on multiple image classification benchmarks, demonstrating flexibility and effectiveness.

title: Multilevel Domain Uncertainty Quantification in Computational Electromagnetics
relevance_to_user: 该论文的多层级不确定量化方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但缺乏植入物设计约束处理。
why_not_core: No implant/biomechanics context, no constraint handling, and no demonstration on structural mechanics problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决计算电磁学中几何不确定性的高效量化问题
summary_zh.method: 采用仿射参数化形状映射与多层级蒙特卡洛/稀疏网格方法
summary_zh.result: 实现了维度无关的代数收敛率，稀疏网格方法克服了维数灾难
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值实验验证理论收敛率与稀疏网格优越性

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently quantify domain uncertainty in time-harmonic electromagnetic problems with random geometries.
summary_en.method: An affine-parametric shape parametrization combined with multilevel Monte Carlo and multilevel sparse-grid quadrature on a nominal polygonal domain.
summary_en.result: Dimension-independent algebraic convergence rates are achieved, and sparse-grid methods overcome the curse of dimensionality.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments confirm theoretical convergence rates and demonstrate superiority of sparse-grid methods.

title: Generative structured normalizing flow Gaussian processes applied to spectroscopic data
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的生成模型结合了条件归一化流和高斯过程，能够处理高维输出并提供不确定性量化，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的约束优化与不确定性传播。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or multi-objective constrained optimization; it focuses on spectroscopic data in physical sciences.

summary_zh.motivation: 物理科学中有限训练数据导致预测不确定性难以量化，尤其在推断新数据时。
summary_zh.method: 提出结构化条件归一化流与高斯过程回归结合的生成模型，学习输入到高维输出的映射。
summary_zh.result: 模型能生成与化学成分条件匹配的真实光谱，并量化新观测光谱的化学成分不确定性。
summary_zh.validation: 在火星探测器ChemCam的激光诱导击穿光谱数据上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Limited training data in physical sciences leads to inadequate uncertainty characterization in input-output mapping, especially during extrapolation.
summary_en.method: A generative model combining structured conditional normalizing flows with Gaussian process regression to map inputs to high-dimensional outputs with exact likelihood and uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.result: The model generates realistic spectra conditioned on chemical composition and enables uncertainty quantification of chemical compositions from new observed spectra.
summary_en.validation: Validated on laser-induced breakdown spectroscopy data from the ChemCam instrument onboard the Mars rover Curiosity.

visual.caption: Figure 1: Gaussian process predictive distribution (mean line with shading for 95% uncertainty interval) as a function of SiO 2 composition for three of the 15 normalizing flow latent dimensions. The predictive mean describes the patterns in the data accurately and the uncertainty intervals appear to capture the majority of the data.

title: Error-Aware B-PINNs: Improving Uncertainty Quantification in Bayesian Physics-Informed Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种改进贝叶斯物理信息神经网络不确定性量化的方法，但仅在线性ODE上验证，未涉及FEA或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: No FEA validation, no biomedical context, no implant mechanics, and only tested on linear ODEs.

summary_zh.motivation: PINN缺乏可信度，需要不确定性量化方法。
summary_zh.method: 提出误差感知B-PINN框架，利用线性动力系统误差界量化不确定性。
summary_zh.result: 在线性ODE上展示了预测不确定性。
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试（线性ODE）。

summary_en.motivation: Physics-Informed Neural Networks lack credibility, motivating the need for uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: Proposes an error-aware Bayesian PINN framework that incorporates discrepancy between B-PINN solution and true solution using error bounds for linear dynamical systems.
summary_en.result: Demonstrates predictive uncertainty on a class of linear ODEs.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks of linear ODEs.

key_terms.zh: 贝叶斯物理信息神经网络

We solve the equation u ′ + 3 ​ u = f u^{\prime}+3u=f with various source terms, using methodolody from Section 3.1 combined with Variational Inference. We do not aim for the perfectly trained model on purpose. We see that uncertainty coming from underfitting is not always captured well, especially in the region where model was not trained (white region in the figures).

title: BelNet: Basis enhanced learning, a mesh-free neural operator
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的网格无关神经算子方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及约束处理或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification, and no application to implant or biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有算子学习方法受限于网格离散化，需要网格无关的神经算子。
summary_zh.method: 提出BelNet，通过学习基函数实现输入输出函数在不同网格上的映射。
summary_zh.result: 在高对比度和多尺度问题上优于其他算子学习方法。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个数值基准问题验证性能。

summary_en.motivation: Existing operator learning methods are constrained by mesh discretization, motivating a mesh-free neural operator.
summary_en.method: BelNet projects input functions into a latent space and reconstructs output functions by learning basis functions during training.
summary_en.result: Outperforms other operator learning methods on challenging high-contrast and multiscale problems.
summary_en.validation: Validated on several numerical benchmark problems including high-contrast and multiscale PDEs.

visual.caption: Figure 7 : Plots of two solutions to the viscous Burgers’ equation with our initialization procedure. Note that each example’s sampling points (black dots) for the initial condition differ. The yellow curves are used to generate the initial conditions for the model problem (viscous Burgers’ equation). The initial conditions for the viscous Burgers’ equation are displayed in blue.

title: Reliable extrapolation of deep neural operators informed by physics or sparse observations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的外推可靠学习方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型，解决训练数据外推预测的难题。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to implant or biomechanics design, nor does it address constraints or uncertainty quantification in optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决深度神经算子在外推场景下预测失效的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出基于微调或多保真度学习的五种可靠外推方法
summary_zh.result: 在多种参数化PDE上验证了外推预测的可靠性
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证方法有效性

summary_en.motivation: To address the failure of deep neural operators when making predictions outside the training data support.
summary_en.method: Proposes five reliable extrapolation methods based on fine-tuning or multifidelity learning, leveraging PDEs or sparse observations.
summary_en.result: Demonstrates effectiveness on various parametric PDEs, providing guidelines for method selection.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks of parametric PDEs.

title: Dual Accuracy-Quality-Driven Neural Network for Prediction Interval Generation
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种生成预测区间的新方法，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to FEA surrogate modeling, implant design, or biomechanics; it focuses on general regression tasks with benchmark datasets.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高深度学习回归模型的不确定性量化可靠性。
summary_zh.method: 设计双网络架构和新型损失函数，同时优化预测区间宽度和覆盖率。
summary_zh.result: 在多个基准数据集上生成更窄且保持名义覆盖率的预测区间。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成数据、八个基准数据集和真实作物产量数据集上验证。

summary_en.motivation: To enhance the reliability of deep learning regression models by generating high-quality prediction intervals that are both narrow and probabilistically accurate.
summary_en.method: A dual neural network architecture with a novel loss function that jointly minimizes mean prediction interval width and maximizes coverage probability via a self-adaptive balancing coefficient.
summary_en.result: The proposed method produces significantly narrower prediction intervals while maintaining nominal coverage compared to three state-of-the-art methods across multiple datasets.
summary_en.validation: Validation on synthetic data, eight benchmark datasets, and a real-world crop yield prediction dataset.

title: Transfer Learning Enhanced DeepONet for Long-Time Prediction of Evolution Equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的迁移学习增强DeepONet方法可提高长时间预测稳定性，适用于代理模型构建，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No biomedical context, no implant mechanics, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决DeepONet在长时间预测中的稳定性退化问题
summary_zh.method: 使用迁移学习顺序更新不同时间段的DeepONet代理模型
summary_zh.result: 提高了长时间预测精度，降低了训练样本需求
summary_zh.validation: 在多个演化方程数值基准上验证

summary_en.motivation: To address the stability degradation of DeepONet in long-time prediction of evolution equations.
summary_en.method: Proposes a transfer learning framework that sequentially updates DeepONets as surrogates for propagators across different time frames.
summary_en.result: The method improves long-time accuracy while maintaining computational efficiency and reducing training sample size.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks of several evolution equations.

title: Selective laser melting of Ti6Al4V alloy: Effect of post-processing on fatigue life, residual stress, microstructure, microhardness and surface roughness
first_author_affiliation: Celal Bayar University, Engineering Faculty, Mechanical Engineering, 45140 Manisa, Türkiye

corresponding_authors.name: Sinan Önder
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Celal Bayar University, Engineering Faculty, Mechanical Engineering, 45140 Manisa, Türkiye

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了LPBF Ti6Al4V后处理对疲劳、残余应力和表面粗糙度的影响，对生物医学植入物的疲劳性能和表面改性有参考价值。
why_not_core: Does not address porous structures, stress shielding, or osseointegration, nor is it specifically focused on biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究后处理对SLM Ti6Al4V疲劳性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 进行多种后处理并测试疲劳、残余应力等
summary_zh.result: 后处理显著改善疲劳寿命和表面质量
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测试验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of post-processing treatments on the fatigue life and surface quality of selective laser melted Ti6Al4V alloy.
summary_en.method: Various post-processing techniques (heat treatment, surface finishing) were applied and characterized via fatigue testing, residual stress measurement, microstructural analysis, and surface roughness measurement.
summary_en.result: Post-processing treatments significantly improved fatigue life, reduced residual stress, and enhanced surface finish.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation through mechanical testing and material characterization.

title: Information-Theoretic Safe Exploration with Gaussian Processes
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的信息论安全探索方法可迁移至生物力学设计中的约束优化问题，但未涉及有限元代理模型或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or expensive simulation sampling; it focuses on safe exploration for unknown constraints in sequential decision making.

summary_zh.motivation: 在未知安全约束下高效探索参数空间，避免违反约束。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于信息论的安全探索准则，利用高斯过程后验识别最安全且信息量最大的参数。
summary_zh.result: 方法在连续域上自然适用，无需额外超参数，且能保证高概率安全并精确学习约束。
summary_zh.validation: 在数值基准测试上验证数据效率和可扩展性。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently explore parameter spaces under unknown safety constraints without violating them during sequential decision making.
summary_en.method: An information-theoretic safe exploration criterion that leverages Gaussian process posteriors to select the most informative safe parameters for evaluation.
summary_en.result: The method naturally applies to continuous domains, requires no additional hyperparameters, and guarantees high-probability safety while learning the constraint to arbitrary precision.
summary_en.validation: Empirical evaluations on numerical benchmarks demonstrate improved data efficiency and scalability.

title: A PINN Approach to Symbolic Differential Operator Discovery with Sparse Data
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种结合PINN和符号回归的方法，用于从稀疏数据中发现微分算子，可迁移至生物力学代理模型构建。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on symbolic discovery of differential operators from sparse data, not on surrogate modeling for expensive simulations, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification in implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 从稀疏实验数据中发现控制系统的微分算子。
summary_zh.method: 修改PINN架构，添加神经网络学习隐藏项，并用符号回归转化为符号方程。
summary_zh.result: 在ODE和PDE场景下，仅用少量噪声数据即可发现隐藏项。
summary_zh.validation: 在数值基准上测试，使用合成稀疏数据验证。

summary_en.motivation: To discover symbolic differential operators governing a system from sparse experimental data.
summary_en.method: A modified PINN approach that learns hidden terms via an additional neural network and converts them to symbolic equations using symbolic regression.
summary_en.result: The method successfully recovers hidden terms in both ODE and PDE regimes with very few noisy measurements.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks using synthetic sparse data.

title: The Influence of Laser Powder Bed Fusion (L-PBF) Process Parameters on 3D-Printed Quality and Stress–Strain Behavior of High-Entropy Alloy (HEA) Rod-Lattices
first_author_affiliation: School of Mechanical and Power Engineering, East China University of Science and Technology, Shanghai 200237, China

corresponding_authors.name: Bo Li
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Mechanical and Power Engineering, East China University of Science and Technology, Shanghai 200237, China

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及激光粉末床熔融工艺参数对高熵合金杆状点阵的成型质量和力学行为的影响，虽然未直接针对生物医学植入物，但其关于点阵结构工艺-性能关系的研究方法可为生物医用多孔植入物的制造提供参考。
why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical implant applications, stress shielding, stiffness matching, fatigue behavior, or osseointegration; it focuses on process parameters and static mechanical properties of high-entropy alloy rod-lattices.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高激光粉末床熔融打印杆状点阵的成型质量和重复一致性。
summary_zh.method: 通过控制实验和表面粗糙度分析，研究工艺参数对CoCrFeNiMn高熵合金微杆缺陷的影响。
summary_zh.result: 缺陷主要由激光能量扩散和粉末不完全熔化引起，力学性能与相对密度正相关。
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸和压缩实验评估微杆和点阵的力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the forming quality and reproducibility of rod-lattices fabricated by laser powder bed fusion.
summary_en.method: The influence of process parameters on defects in CoCrFeNiMn high-entropy alloy micro-rods was investigated through control experiments and surface roughness analysis.
summary_en.result: Defects primarily arise from laser energy diffusion and incomplete powder melting, and mechanical properties show a positive correlation with relative density.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical properties were evaluated via tensile testing of micro-rods and compression testing of lattice structures.

title: Physics-guided Data Augmentation for Learning the Solution Operator of Linear Differential Equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的物理引导数据增强方法可提高神经算子模型的样本效率，有望迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模中，但未涉及约束处理或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics design; it focuses solely on linear PDEs without biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 神经算子模型训练需要大量数值模拟数据，效率低下。
summary_zh.method: 利用线性微分方程的物理性质（线性、平移）进行数据增强。
summary_zh.result: 提高了神经算子模型的准确性和泛化能力，对分布偏移鲁棒。
summary_zh.validation: 在多种线性微分方程上验证了样本效率提升。

summary_en.motivation: Training neural operator models requires large amounts of ground truth data from slow numerical solvers, limiting efficiency.
summary_en.method: Proposes a physics-guided data augmentation method that leverages linearity and translation properties of differential equations to augment training data.
summary_en.result: The method improves accuracy and generalization of neural operator models, reducing sample complexity and enhancing robustness to distributional shift.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a variety of linear differential equations, demonstrating improved sample efficiency and robustness.

title: Effect of heat treatment on the variable amplitude fatigue life and microstructure of the novel bioinspired Ti‐6Al‐4V thin tubes fabricated using Selective Laser Melting process
venue: Fatigue & Fracture of Engineering Materials & Structures
first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering Indian Institute of Technology Madras  Chennai India

corresponding_authors.name: Somashekhar S. Hiremath
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering Indian Institute of Technology Madras  Chennai India

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了SLM制造钛合金薄管的热处理对疲劳性能的影响，可为生物植入物疲劳设计提供参考。
why_not_core: Does not directly address porous implant structures for stress shielding reduction or osseointegration, missing implant-specific biomechanical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究热处理对SLM制造仿生薄管变幅疲劳性能及微观结构的影响
summary_zh.method: 以Euplectella aspergillum为灵感设计薄管，采用SLM制造并进行热处理与变幅疲劳测试
summary_zh.result: 热处理显著降低残余应力，提高疲劳寿命，但强度略有下降
summary_zh.validation: 通过变幅疲劳实验和微观结构表征验证热处理效果

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of heat treatment on the variable amplitude fatigue behavior and microstructure of SLM-fabricated bioinspired Ti-6Al-4V thin tubes.
summary_en.method: Thin tubes mimicking Euplectella aspergillum architecture were fabricated by selective laser melting, followed by heat treatment and variable amplitude fatigue testing.
summary_en.result: Heat treatment substantially reduced residual stresses and increased fatigue life at the expense of a slight decrease in strength.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through variable amplitude fatigue experiments and microstructural analysis.

title: AutoPINN: When AutoML Meets Physics-Informed Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出自动化设计PINN的框架，可迁移至生物力学代理模型的设计，但未涉及FEA或植入物优化。
why_not_core: No FEA surrogate modeling, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification, and no biomechanics or implant design context.

summary_zh.motivation: 手动设计PINN耗时且性能次优，需自动化设计。
summary_zh.method: 结合AutoML与PINN，设计搜索空间和资源感知搜索策略。
summary_zh.result: 自动找到比人工设计更精确的PINN模型，且资源消耗更少。
summary_zh.validation: 在电力电子变换器参数估计任务上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Manual design of PINNs is time-consuming and often suboptimal, motivating automated architecture and hyperparameter search.
summary_en.method: AutoPINN combines AutoML with PINNs by defining a tailored search space and a resource-aware search strategy to find high-accuracy models under resource constraints.
summary_en.result: AutoPINN discovers PINN models that outperform human-designed state-of-the-art models in accuracy while using fewer resources.
summary_en.validation: Validated on the task of estimating internal parameters (capacitance) of power electronic converters from observable current and voltage.

title: A probabilistic peridynamic framework with an application to the study of the statistical size effect
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多层级蒙特卡洛方法可显著降低昂贵数值模拟的不确定性量化成本，对生物力学植入物设计的代理模型构建具有迁移价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant design, lacks biomedical context, and focuses on peridynamic models for material failure rather than biomechanical simulations.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低近场动力学模型不确定性量化中的高昂计算成本
summary_zh.method: 采用多层级蒙特卡洛方法，粗网格为主、细网格为辅进行模拟
summary_zh.result: 相比标准蒙特卡洛方法实现16倍加速，同时估计离散误差和采样误差
summary_zh.validation: 通过准脆性材料统计尺寸效应数值算例验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the prohibitive computational cost of uncertainty quantification in peridynamic models for material failure.
summary_en.method: A Multilevel Monte Carlo framework is employed, performing most simulations on coarse meshes and few on fine meshes to accelerate uncertainty propagation.
summary_en.result: A 16x speed-up over standard Monte Carlo is achieved, with simultaneous estimation of discretization and sampling errors.
summary_en.validation: The approach is validated through a numerical study of the statistical size effect in quasi-brittle materials.

title: General multi-fidelity surrogate models: Framework and active learning strategies for efficient rare event simulation
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多保真度代理模型和主动学习策略可用于生物力学植入物设计中的稀有事件（如失效概率）估计，但未涉及植入物或生物力学具体应用。
why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics context; no demonstration on structural mechanics or patient-specific design; no uncertainty quantification on surrogate predictions beyond failure probability.

summary_zh.motivation: 高保真模型计算昂贵，难以估计小失效概率。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于高斯过程校正和模型平均的多保真度代理模型，结合子集模拟和主动学习。
summary_zh.result: 在多个案例中大幅减少高保真模型调用次数，同时保持高精度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过解析和数值案例验证，包括TRISO核燃料失效概率评估。

summary_en.motivation: Estimating failure probabilities for complex systems using high-fidelity models is computationally prohibitive, especially for rare events.
summary_en.method: A multi-fidelity surrogate framework is developed using Gaussian process corrections for low-fidelity models, fused via model averaging or selection within an active learning subset simulation.
summary_en.result: The method achieves high accuracy with drastically reduced high-fidelity model calls across analytical and numerical case studies.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on two analytical and two numerical examples, including a TRISO nuclear fuel failure probability case.

title: Dimensional assessment of uniformly periodic porosity primitive TPMS lattices using additive manufacturing laser powder bed fusion technique
venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology
first_author_affiliation: Additive Design and Manufacturing Systems Laboratory, University of Alberta, Edmonton, AB, Canada

why_not_core: This paper does not address implant design, biomechanics, or any biomedical application; it focuses on pure PDE solving with Fourier continuation.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准PINO对非周期PDE精度差，需改进边界处理。
summary_zh.method: 将Fourier延拓集成到PINO中，实现非周期信号的精确导数计算。
summary_zh.result: FC-PINO在非周期非光滑PDE上显著优于PINO，精度高且鲁棒。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个非周期PDE基准测试验证精度和可扩展性。

summary_en.motivation: Standard PINO suffers from Gibbs phenomena and low accuracy for non-periodic PDEs due to the periodicity assumption in spectral differentiation.
summary_en.method: FC-PINO integrates Fourier continuation (FC-Legendre and FC-Gram) into the PINO framework to enable accurate derivative computation for non-periodic signals.
summary_en.result: FC-PINO achieves high-precision solutions on non-periodic and non-smooth PDE benchmarks, substantially outperforming PINO with or without padding.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on challenging non-periodic PDEs demonstrate accuracy, robustness, and scalability compared to PINO baselines.

corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopaedics, Peking University Third Hospital, Beijing, China

corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Tsinghua University, Beijing, China

relevance_to_user: 该综述涵盖了增材制造镁合金在骨缺损修复中的应用，但未涉及应力遮挡或疲劳测试。
why_not_core: This is a review paper with no original experimental data, no LPBF fabrication, no mechanical testing, and no fatigue or stress shielding analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 骨缺损修复中镁合金植入物的降解与力学性能控制是主要挑战。
summary_zh.method: 通过文献计量分析和综述，总结增材制造镁合金的研究现状。
summary_zh.result: 指出降解速率控制和力学性能优化是当前研究重点。
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，为文献综述。

summary_en.motivation: Bone defect repair requires implants with controlled degradation and suitable mechanical properties, motivating a review of additively manufactured magnesium alloys.
summary_en.method: Bibliometric analysis and literature review were conducted to summarize the state of research on AM-Mg alloys for bone defects.
summary_en.result: Degradation control and mechanical property optimization are identified as the main research focuses.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; this is a review paper.

visual.caption: YS (MPa) and elastic modulus (GPa) of Mg and its alloys are more similar to natural bone than those of other biodegradable metallic materials (such as Fe and Zn) and Polyetheretherketone (PEEK) (Chen et al., 2022; Wang et al., 2022).

title: Physics-informed Neural Networks with Unknown Measurement Noise
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种处理非高斯噪声的PINN方法，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No application to FEA surrogate modeling, no implant or biomechanics context, and no constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准PINN在非高斯噪声下失效，需改进噪声建模。
summary_zh.method: 联合训练能量模型学习噪声分布，增强PINN鲁棒性。
summary_zh.result: 在多个数值示例中改善了PINN对非高斯噪声的适应性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证方法有效性。

summary_en.motivation: Standard PINNs fail under non-Gaussian noise, motivating a robust noise modeling approach.
summary_en.method: Jointly train an energy-based model to learn the noise distribution alongside the PINN.
summary_en.result: Improved PINN performance on multiple examples with non-Gaussian noise.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmark problems with synthetic noise.

title: Physics Informed Neural Network for Dynamic Stress Prediction
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于物理信息神经网络的动态应力预测方法，可迁移至生物力学中的植入物应力分析，但未涉及约束处理或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address multi-objective constraints, uncertainty quantification, or implant-specific biomechanics; it focuses on dynamic stress prediction for structural engineering.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低动态应力预测的计算成本，实现实时预测。
summary_zh.method: 将偏微分方程嵌入深度神经网络损失函数，构建PINN-Stress模型。
summary_zh.result: 模型可近实时预测应力分布序列，且泛化能力优于无PINN模型。
summary_zh.validation: 基于有限元模拟的数值算例验证。

summary_en.motivation: To enable real-time prediction of dynamic stress distributions during catastrophic events while reducing the computational cost of high-fidelity finite element models.
summary_en.method: A Physics Informed Neural Network (PINN-Stress) is proposed that embeds a partial differential equation into the loss function via automatic differentiation, trained on finite element simulation data.
summary_en.result: The PINN-Stress model predicts the entire stress distribution sequence in near real-time and demonstrates better generalization than a standard neural network without physics constraints.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed using numerical simulation cases from a finite element PDE solver.

visual.caption: Figure 2 : Model architecture: We introduce the novel spatiotemporal multiplexing (STM) to physics-informed learning in order to learn both spatial and temporal information in the data. Our architecture is lightweight and hence gives real-time performance.

title: Incremental Spatial and Spectral Learning of Neural Operators for Solving Large-Scale PDEs
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种增量训练神经算子的方法，可提高大规模PDE求解效率，对用户构建高效FEA代理模型具有参考价值。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on general PDE solving (turbulent flows) without any biomedical or implant mechanics context, and lacks uncertainty quantification or constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决FNO在高分辨率PDE求解中的计算开销和频率选择问题
summary_zh.method: 提出增量式FNO，逐步增加频率模式数和训练数据分辨率
summary_zh.result: 在保持或提升泛化性能的同时，训练时间减少30%，测试误差降低10%
summary_zh.validation: 在多个标准PDE数据集上进行数值基准测试

summary_en.motivation: To address the computational burden and frequency selection challenges of Fourier Neural Operators when solving large-scale, high-resolution PDEs.
summary_en.method: Introduces Incremental Fourier Neural Operator (iFNO) that progressively increases the number of frequency modes and training data resolution.
summary_en.result: iFNO achieves 10% lower testing error with 20% fewer frequency modes and 30% faster training compared to standard FNO.
summary_en.validation: Validated on multiple benchmark PDE datasets including turbulent flow simulations.

visual.caption: Figure 3 : FNO with higher frequency modes captures smaller-scale structures in the turbulence. Prediction of the Kolmogorov flow by FNO with K = 10 K=10 and K = 90 K=90 . Insufficient modes lead to overly strong dumping and it fails to capture small-scale structures in the turbulence of Kolmogorov flow.

title: High-dimensional inverse modeling of hydraulic tomography by physics informed neural network (HT-PINN)
first_author_affiliation: School of Civil and Environmental Engineering, Georgia Institute of Technology, Atlanta, GA 30332-0355, USA

corresponding_authors.name: Jian Luo
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Civil and Environmental Engineering, Georgia Institute of Technology, Atlanta, GA 30332-0355, USA

relevance_to_user: 该论文将PINN应用于高维反问题，方法可迁移至生物力学代理建模，但缺乏植入物相关验证。
why_not_core: No implant mechanics, no biomechanics context, no experimental validation in biomedical domain.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决高维水文层析反演计算成本高的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出HT-PINN框架，将物理信息嵌入神经网络进行参数反演
summary_zh.result: HT-PINN在合成案例中准确重建渗透率场，效率优于传统方法
summary_zh.validation: 通过合成数值案例验证反演精度和效率

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of high-dimensional inverse modeling in hydraulic tomography.
summary_en.method: Proposes HT-PINN, a physics-informed neural network framework that embeds governing equations into the loss function for parameter inversion.
summary_en.result: HT-PINN accurately reconstructs permeability fields in synthetic cases with significantly higher efficiency than traditional methods.
summary_en.validation: Validated on synthetic numerical cases comparing inversion accuracy and computational cost.

title: c-TPE: Tree-structured Parzen Estimator with Inequality Constraints for Expensive Hyperparameter Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了处理不等式约束的贝叶斯优化方法，可迁移至植入物设计中的约束优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on hyperparameter optimization for deep learning, not on surrogate modeling for FEA or biomechanical design, and lacks validation on engineering or biomedical problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 深度学习超参数优化常需满足内存、延迟等约束，现有TPE方法无法处理。
summary_zh.method: 提出c-TPE，通过修改TPE的密度估计和采集函数处理不等式约束。
summary_zh.result: 在81个昂贵约束HPO任务上平均排名最优，统计显著。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准HPO基准问题上进行数值实验对比。

summary_en.motivation: Hyperparameter optimization in deep learning often involves constraints such as memory or latency, which are not handled by the standard TPE method.
summary_en.method: We propose c-TPE, an extension of TPE that modifies density estimation and acquisition function to handle inequality constraints.
summary_en.result: c-TPE achieves the best average rank performance with statistical significance on 81 expensive constrained HPO tasks.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on standard HPO benchmarks with numerical comparisons against existing baselines.

title: Multi-fidelity Gaussian Process for Biomanufacturing Process Modeling with Small Data
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多保真高斯过程方法可解决生物制造中的小数据建模问题，其框架可迁移至植入物力学代理建模中的多保真数据融合与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on bioprocess modeling (bioreactor scale-up, cell line transfer) rather than FEA surrogate modeling for implant mechanics, and lacks validation on solid mechanics or biomedical implant design problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 生物制造中数据稀缺且昂贵，需高效建模方法。
summary_zh.method: 采用多保真高斯过程融合不同精度数据源进行建模。
summary_zh.result: 在生物反应器放大和细胞系知识迁移中验证了有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 基于真实生物工艺数据集进行案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: Accurate modeling of bioprocess dynamics is hindered by high data acquisition cost and limited data availability.
summary_en.method: A multi-fidelity Gaussian process regression framework is proposed to integrate information from multiple fidelity levels for process modeling with small data.
summary_en.result: The method demonstrates efficacy on real-world bioprocess datasets for bioreactor scale-up and knowledge transfer across cell lines.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed using real-world biomanufacturing datasets, showing improved prediction accuracy over single-fidelity models.

visual.caption: Figure 1: An illustration of the GP and MFGP models. In the left figure, only six data points from the high fidelity function are available to train a GP model, of which the posterior mean and two standard deviation band are shown. In the right figure, in addition to the six high-fidelity data points, twelve data points from the low fidelity function are available. An MFGP model is trained using both the low-fidelity and high-fidelity data, with the posterior mean and two standard deviation band shown.

title: Looking at the posterior: accuracy and uncertainty of neural-network predictions
relevance_to_user: 该论文探讨了神经网络预测中的不确定性量化方法，可迁移至代理模型中的不确定性估计，但未涉及有限元或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address expensive simulation sampling efficiency, constraint handling, or implant/biomechanics design; it focuses on general neural network uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 量化神经网络预测中的不确定性，并理解其与准确性的关系。
summary_zh.method: 使用深度集成近似后验，分析认知不确定性和偶然不确定性对准确性的影响。
summary_zh.result: 发现准确性依赖于两种不确定性的复杂交互，并提出新的主动学习采集函数。
summary_zh.validation: 在全连接、卷积和注意力网络上进行数值基准测试。

summary_en.motivation: To quantify uncertainty in neural network predictions and understand its relationship with prediction accuracy.
summary_en.method: Posteriors are approximated using deep ensembles, and the interplay between epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty is analyzed.
summary_en.result: Prediction accuracy depends intricately on both uncertainty types, and a novel acquisition function outperforms common methods in active learning.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on fully-connected, convolutional, and attention-based neural networks.

title: Ensemble Multi-Quantiles: Adaptively Flexible Distribution Prediction for Uncertainty Quantification
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的集成多分位数方法可用于不确定性量化，可迁移至代理模型中的预测不确定性评估。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to FEA surrogate modeling, implant design, or biomechanics; it only validates on UCI regression benchmarks.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有不确定性量化方法在灵活性与泛化性之间难以平衡。
summary_zh.method: 提出集成多分位数方法，通过自适应提升逐步偏离高斯分布。
summary_zh.result: 在UCI回归任务上达到最先进性能。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个UCI数据集上与其他方法对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing uncertainty quantification methods struggle to balance distributional flexibility and generalization.
summary_en.method: An ensemble multi-quantile approach is proposed that adaptively boosts quantiles to depart from Gaussian assumptions.
summary_en.result: State-of-the-art performance is achieved on extensive UCI regression benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on multiple UCI datasets and compared with recent uncertainty quantification methods.

summary_en.method: TiNbTaZrMo high-entropy alloy was fabricated via selective laser melting, and process parameters were varied to control the elastic modulus.
summary_en.result: Alloys with a range of Young's moduli were successfully produced, demonstrating tunability.

why_not_core: This paper uses phase-field simulation only, with no LPBF fabrication, no mechanical testing, no fatigue analysis, and no surface roughness or osseointegration data.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估TPMS多孔泡沫在压缩载荷下的断裂行为
summary_zh.method: 采用3D相场模型模拟五种TPMS结构的断裂过程

summary_en.motivation: To assess fracture behavior of TPMS open foams under compressive loading for engineering and biomedical applications.
summary_en.method: A 3D phase field model was applied to simulate crack nucleation and propagation in five TPMS unit cell types at various porosities.
summary_en.result: Predicted stiffness and strength trends agree with literature, showing TPMS foams outperform conventional aluminum foams.
summary_en.validation: Numerical results were compared with previous TPMS studies from the literature.

title: MP-GELU Bayesian Neural Networks: Moment Propagation by GELU Nonlinearity
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种新的激活函数MP-GELU，用于贝叶斯神经网络中的不确定性量化，可加速矩传播，对构建高效代理模型具有潜在价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to finite element analysis, surrogate modeling, or implant/biomechanics design; it focuses on general regression tasks without any structural or contact mechanics context.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有BNN中非线性函数的矩传播计算昂贵，需要更快的传播方法。
summary_zh.method: 提出MP-GELU激活函数，通过解析计算输入统计量的非线性变换实现快速矩传播。
summary_zh.result: 在回归任务中，MP-GELU比ReLU基BNN具有更高预测精度和更好不确定性质量，且执行更快。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准回归数据集上进行数值实验对比。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of moment propagation in Bayesian neural networks caused by expensive Taylor expansions for nonlinearities.
summary_en.method: Proposes MP-GELU, a novel activation function that enables analytical computation of first and second moments by applying nonlinearity to input statistics.
summary_en.result: MP-GELU achieves higher prediction accuracy and better uncertainty quality with faster execution than ReLU-based BNNs on regression tasks.
summary_en.validation: Empirical evaluation on standard regression benchmarks comparing against ReLU-based BNNs.

why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication, no fatigue testing, no surface roughness or osseointegration analysis, and no direct link to stress shielding or stiffness matching for biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究高孔隙率多孔钛的能量吸收特性及其制备方法。
summary_zh.method: 采用冷等静压和NaCl空间保持剂制备多孔钛，并进行准静态压缩测试。
summary_zh.result: 多孔钛的能量吸收随应变增加而提高，随孔隙率增加而降低；杨氏模量和平台应力与相对密度呈幂律关系。
summary_zh.validation: 通过准静态压缩实验验证力学性能与能量吸收特性。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the energy absorption characteristics of porous titanium with high porosity for potential industrial applications.
summary_en.method: Porous titanium with porosity above 58% was fabricated via cold isostatic pressing using NaCl as a space holder, followed by quasi-static compression tests.
summary_en.result: Energy absorption increases with strain at constant porosity but decreases with increasing porosity; Young's modulus and plateau stress follow a power-law relationship with relative density.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing under quasi-static compression at a strain rate of 10⁻³ s⁻¹ was used to validate the energy absorption and mechanical properties.

why_not_core: This paper does not quantify stress shielding in Gruen zones or report micromotion values with contact/friction modeling; it lacks comparison between intact and implanted femur.

summary_zh.motivation: 设计并预测多孔股骨柄的力学性能，以优化植入物固定。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of uncertainty estimation in deep neural networks while maintaining reliability.
summary_en.method: A sampling-free approach that trains the network to produce consistent outputs with and without additional information, using the network's own prediction as prior at inference time and measuring uncertainty as the distance between the two outputs.
summary_en.result: The method achieves uncertainty estimates comparable to Deep Ensembles on classification and regression tasks at a significantly lower computational cost.
summary_en.validation: Validated on multiple benchmark datasets for classification and regression tasks.

visual.caption: Figure 1 : ZigZaging. At inference time, we make two forward passes. First, we use [ 𝐱 , 0 ] [\mathbf{x},\textbf{0}] as input to produce a prediction 𝐲 0 \mathbf{y}_{0} . Second, we feed [ 𝐱 , 𝐲 0 ] [\mathbf{x},\mathbf{y}_{0}] to the network and generate 𝐲 1 \mathbf{y}_{1} . We take ‖ 𝐲 0 − 𝐲 1 ‖ \|\mathbf{y}_{0}-\mathbf{y}_{1}\| to be our uncertainty estimate. In essence, the second pass performs a reconstruction in much the same way an auto-encoder does and a high reconstruction error correlates with uncertainty.

summary_en.motivation: Existing closed-loop optimization methods either lack global convergence guarantees or have no known optimality guarantee, motivating a provably efficient constrained optimization algorithm.

summary_en.result: CONFIG achieves competitive performance to the popular Constrained Expected Improvement algorithm on both a numerical benchmark and a continuous stirred-tank reactor optimization problem, while providing a provable global optimality guarantee.
summary_en.validation: The algorithm is validated on an artificial numerical benchmark and a classical constrained steady-state optimization problem of a continuous stirred-tank reactor.

summary_en.result: The proposed method outperforms fully connected DNNs of the same size on regression and classification benchmarks, and adaptive PINNs show superior accuracy and interpretability for PDEs.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on prototype regression/classification problems and elliptic PDE forward/inverse problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准PINN难以求解强非线性或高频演化PDE。

summary_en.method: PT-PINN pre-trains on small time subdomains and progressively expands to larger ones, providing initialization and supervised data.

summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks including nonlinear heat equation, Allen-Cahn equation, and convection equation.

title: The Implicit Delta Method
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种新的不确定性量化方法，可应用于替代模型，但未涉及FEA或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or any biomedical application; it focuses on a general statistical method for uncertainty quantification in predictive models.

summary_zh.motivation: 复杂模型评估中的不确定性量化困难，传统方法计算成本高。
summary_zh.method: 提出隐式Delta方法，通过微扰正则化训练损失自动评估下游不确定性。
summary_zh.result: 正则化引起的评估变化与渐近方差一致，可构建校准置信区间。
summary_zh.validation: 在数值基准上验证了标准误和置信区间的可靠性。

summary_en.motivation: Uncertainty quantification in downstream evaluations of complex predictive models is challenging due to computational infeasibility of the bootstrap.
summary_en.method: The implicit delta method infinitesimally regularizes the training loss to automatically assess downstream uncertainty, approximating the finite difference.
summary_en.result: The change in evaluation due to regularization is consistent for the asymptotic variance, enabling calibrated confidence intervals.
summary_en.validation: Empirical validation on numerical benchmarks demonstrates reliable standard errors and confidence interval coverage.

summary_zh.motivation: 将机器学习代理模型集成到优化套件中，解决数据驱动的约束优化问题。
summary_zh.method: 比较GPR、SVR和ANN模型，结合不确定性量化方法，在Gekko优化框架中求解核废料玻璃化问题。
summary_zh.result: GPR结合共形不确定性预测出更高的废物装载量（37.5 wt%），优于传统PQM模型。

summary_en.method: Compared Gaussian process regression, support vector regression, and artificial neural network models with various uncertainty quantification methods within the Gekko optimization framework, applied to a nuclear waste vitrification problem.

summary_en.motivation: Complex mechanistic models with intractable likelihoods and expensive simulations often lead to poor uncertainty quantification when using surrogate models directly for Bayesian inference.
summary_en.method: A new method adjusts approximate posterior samples by optimizing a transformation that maximizes a scoring rule, requiring only a small fixed number of complex model simulations.
summary_en.result: The method reduces bias and improves posterior coverage properties across several examples of increasing complexity.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmark examples demonstrating beneficial corrections to approximate posteriors.

relevance_to_user: 该论文设计了基于三周期极小曲面的连续梯度多孔支架，通过LPBF制造并进行了力学性能测试，与用户研究方向中的多孔结构、刚度匹配和AM制造直接相关。

summary_zh.motivation: 设计和制造与骨匹配力学性能的连续梯度多孔支架。
summary_zh.method: 基于P、G、D三种TPMS结构设计梯度多孔支架，采用LPBF制备NiTiNb合金样品。
summary_zh.result: 支架弹性模量1.5-3.4 GPa，强度75-321 MPa，与人体骨匹配，P型结构综合性能最优。
summary_zh.validation: 通过压缩力学测试和渗透率计算验证性能。

summary_en.motivation: Design a bone-like scaffold with continuous porosity gradient that matches the mechanical properties of human bone.
summary_en.method: Used three TPMS unit cells (Primitive, Gyroid, Diamond) to design gradient porous scaffolds, fabricated by selective laser melting of NiTiNb alloy.
summary_en.result: Scaffolds achieved low elastic modulus (1.5–3.4 GPa) and suitable strength (75–321 MPa), with P-type showing best mechanical and permeability performance.
summary_en.validation: Compression tests and permeability calculations were performed to verify mechanical and fluid transport properties.

title: Combined space-time reduced-order model with 3D deep convolution for extrapolating fluid dynamics
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的3D卷积时空降阶模型可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或约束优化。
why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics context; no constraint handling or uncertainty quantification; validation only on fluid dynamics benchmark.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高深度学习降阶模型在训练数据外的外推能力，用于主动流动控制。
summary_zh.method: 提出耦合时空相关性的3D卷积网络架构，替代标准编码-传播-解码模型。
summary_zh.result: 在圆柱绕流问题中，新模型对雷诺数的外推预测范围优于传统方法。
summary_zh.validation: 基于层流圆柱绕流全阶仿真数据的数值基准测试。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the extrapolation capability of deep learning-based reduced-order models for active flow control tasks beyond training data.
summary_en.method: A novel 3D convolutional network architecture that learns coupled spatio-temporal correlations as an implicit bias.
summary_en.result: The proposed model achieves superior extrapolation performance for velocity and pressure fields at varying Reynolds numbers compared to standard encoder-propagator-decoder networks.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmark on laminar flow past a circular cylinder using full-order simulation snapshots.

why_not_core: This paper is a pure simulation study without LPBF fabrication, mechanical testing, fatigue analysis, or surface characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统牙种植体因刚度不匹配导致应力遮挡，需优化设计匹配骨密度。
summary_zh.method: 设计了五种轴向与径向功能梯度材料种植体，并模拟不同骨密度下的力学响应。
summary_zh.result: 功能梯度材料种植体在高密度骨中产生更优应变，传统种植体在低密度骨中更优。
summary_zh.validation: 仅通过有限元仿真对比应变分布，无实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Conventional dental implants cause stress shielding due to stiffness mismatch; functionally graded materials can tailor implant stiffness to different bone densities.
summary_en.method: Five axial and radial functionally graded material (FGM) implant designs were simulated with five bone densities using finite element analysis.
summary_en.result: FGM implants induced optimal strain (990-1280 με) in high-density bone, whereas conventional implants were optimal (1000-2240 με) in low-density bone.
summary_en.validation: The study relied solely on computational simulation without experimental fabrication or mechanical testing.

why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structure design for stress shielding, mechanical testing (static or fatigue), or osseointegration; it focuses on process physics and defect formation in single-layer LPBF.

summary_zh.motivation: 揭示LPBF中孔隙和驼峰的形成机制，提高工艺可靠性。
summary_zh.method: 结合X射线成像与多相多物理场模拟，量化孔隙演化和熔池不稳定性。
summary_zh.result: 发现孔隙由匙孔塌陷、孔隙合并和凝固前沿捕获形成，驼峰由Kelvin-Helmholtz不稳定性引起。
summary_zh.validation: 通过X射线成像和电子成像验证模拟结果。

summary_en.motivation: To understand the interdependent dynamics of pore and hump formation in laser powder bed fusion for improving process reliability.
summary_en.method: Combined X-ray and electron imaging with high-fidelity multiphase multiphysics simulation to quantify pore evolution, keyhole dynamics, and melt track instabilities.
summary_en.result: Irregular pores form via keyhole collapse, pore coalescence, and entrapment by the solidification front; humps arise from Kelvin-Helmholtz instability at the melt pool surface.
summary_en.validation: Simulation predictions were validated against in-situ X-ray and electron imaging data.

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了金属梯度螺旋结构（gyroid）的增材制造与力学性能，与用户关注的AM生物医学植入物方向直接相关，但未涉及应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
why_not_core: This paper does not link porous structure to stress shielding or stiffness matching, does not cover fatigue testing, and does not report surface roughness or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究梯度螺旋结构在骨组织工程中的力学性能，填补不锈钢支架的空白。
summary_zh.method: 通过LPBF制造厚度梯度、尺寸梯度和均匀三种螺旋结构，进行压缩测试和FEM模拟。
summary_zh.result: 梯度样品具有与均匀样品相当的力学性能，且表现出逐层坍塌和更高能量吸收。
summary_zh.validation: 压缩实验与Gibson-Ashby模型及FEM模拟对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the mechanical properties of functionally graded gyroid structures for bone tissue engineering, addressing the lack of data on stainless steel scaffolds.
summary_en.method: Three design methods (thickness-graded, size-graded, and uniform) of 17-4 PH steel gyroids were fabricated via LPBF and tested under compression, with FEM simulations.
summary_en.result: Graded samples exhibited comparable mechanical properties to uniform ones, with a controlled layer-by-layer collapse and higher energy absorption.
summary_en.validation: Experimental compression results were validated against Gibson-Ashby models and FEM simulations, showing good agreement.

title: Machine learning-based sampling of virtual experiments within the full stress state
relevance_to_user: 该论文的主动学习采样方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型的训练数据高效采样，但未涉及植入物设计或约束处理。
why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics context; no constraint handling or uncertainty quantification; focused on sheet metal yield surfaces.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高虚拟实验采样效率以减少昂贵晶体塑性模拟次数
summary_zh.method: 采用主动学习算法自适应采样全应力状态下的虚拟实验点
summary_zh.result: 新方法采样效率优于传统方法，但全应力采样可能降低面内各向异性表征精度
summary_zh.validation: 与两种经典采样方法对比，并拟合多种屈服函数验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the number of expensive crystal plasticity simulations by efficiently sampling virtual experiments across the full stress state.
summary_en.method: An active learning algorithm is adapted to sequentially select virtual experiments that maximize information gain for identifying anisotropic yield function parameters.
summary_en.result: The active learning approach achieves higher sampling efficiency than two state-of-the-art methods, but sampling the full stress state can degrade in-plane anisotropy representation for certain yield functions.
summary_en.validation: Comparison with two baseline sampling methods using CPFEM simulations for DX56D steel, fitting multiple yield functions (Hill48, Yld91, Yld2004-18p, Yld2004-27p).

why_not_core: This paper does not address implant design, biomechanics, or any biomedical application; it focuses on polycrystalline plasticity and FE2 homogenization.

summary_en.motivation: To develop a computationally efficient surrogate for history-dependent multiscale material models that can replace costly FE2 simulations.
summary_en.method: A recurrent neural operator (RNO) is introduced to learn macroscopic internal variables and history dependence from microscopic crystal plasticity data.
summary_en.result: The RNO achieves FE2-level accuracy at a computational cost comparable to conventional empirical constitutive relations.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on a polycrystalline medium under dynamic loading, comparing RNO predictions with direct FE2 simulations.

relevance_to_user: 该论文使用支持向量回归构建全局代理模型，处理弹塑性力学问题，方法可迁移至植入物设计的有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant-specific biomechanics, uncertainty quantification, or multi-objective constrained optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决弹塑性力学系统中非光滑响应的全局代理建模难题。
summary_zh.method: 采用支持向量回归结合各向异性训练网格和响应面平滑技术。
summary_zh.result: SVR能有效捕捉非光滑行为，平滑技术提高了精度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过一维和二维弹塑性有限元算例验证。

summary_en.motivation: To construct a global surrogate model capable of capturing non-smooth responses in elasto-plastic mechanical systems.
summary_en.method: Support vector regression with anisotropic training grid and response surface smoothing via linear regression is employed.
summary_en.result: SVR effectively handles discontinuous outputs, and smoothing improves accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Validated on one-dimensional phenomenological and two-dimensional finite element elasto-plastic cases.

title: Exact and Approximate Conformal Inference for Multi-Output Regression
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了多输出回归的共形推断方法，可用于代理模型的不确定性量化，但未涉及有限元或生物力学应用。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or any biomedical design context; it focuses on general conformal inference for multi-output regression.

summary_zh.motivation: 机器学习预测缺乏不确定性量化，共形推断计算成本高。
summary_zh.method: 推导了线性预测模型下共形p值的精确公式，并提出了两种近似方法unionCP和multivariate rootCP。
summary_zh.result: 所提方法在保持计算优势的同时，有效构建了多输出预测区域。
summary_zh.validation: 在模拟和真实数据集上进行了数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Machine learning predictions lack uncertainty quantification, and conformal inference is computationally expensive.
summary_en.method: Exact conformal p-values are derived for linear predictive models, and two approximations, unionCP and multivariate rootCP, are proposed for general multi-output predictors.
summary_en.result: The proposed methods efficiently construct prediction regions with guaranteed coverage while preserving computational advantages.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on simulated and real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the methods.

title: Deep Gaussian Process-based Multi-fidelity Bayesian Optimization for Simulated Chemical Reactors

why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or any biomedical design constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 化学反应器几何优化计算昂贵且非线性，需高效优化方法。
summary_zh.method: 采用深度高斯过程建立多保真模型，结合贝叶斯优化探索设计空间。
summary_zh.result: 多保真方法在有限计算预算下有效找到高质量反应器几何。
summary_zh.validation: 通过3D打印反应器实验数据验证不同保真度仿真精度。

summary_en.motivation: Optimizing chemical reactor geometries is computationally expensive and derivative-free, requiring efficient multi-fidelity methods.
summary_en.method: Deep Gaussian processes model five discrete mesh fidelities within a Bayesian optimization framework to balance cost and accuracy.
summary_en.result: The multi-fidelity approach achieves good reactor designs with reduced computational effort.
summary_en.validation: Simulation accuracies across fidelities are validated against experimental data from a 3D-printed reactor.

title: Constrained Efficient Global Optimization of Expensive Black-box Functions
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的约束高效全局优化方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的昂贵黑箱优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not validate on any biomedical or implant design problem, lacks uncertainty quantification beyond Gaussian process regression, and does not address the specific constraints of biomechanical systems.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决昂贵黑箱函数在约束下的高效全局优化问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出CONFIG算法，利用高斯过程同时学习目标和约束。
summary_zh.result: 在常用核函数下获得次线性累积遗憾界和约束违反界。
summary_zh.validation: 在GP采样实例、人工数值问题和建筑控制器调优问题上验证。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently optimize expensive black-box functions subject to constraints, which are also learned via Gaussian processes.
summary_en.method: Proposes CONFIG, a constrained efficient global optimization algorithm that models both objective and constraints with GPs and provides theoretical regret bounds.
summary_en.result: Achieves sublinear cumulative regret and constraint violation bounds for Matern and Squared Exponential kernels, with competitive empirical performance.
summary_en.validation: Validated on synthetic GP samples, artificial numerical problems, and a building controller tuning problem.

summary_zh.method: 采用响应面法系统优化SLM参数（功率、速度、间距）获得高致密样品。
summary_zh.result: 优化后样品相对密度达99.5%，抗拉强度370 MPa，延伸率10.4%。
summary_zh.validation: 通过硬度、拉伸测试及微观组织表征验证力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: To achieve high strength and ductility in Mg-9Al-1Zn-0.5Mn alloy fabricated via selective laser melting, which is challenging due to its poor weldability and low boiling point.
summary_en.method: Response surface methodology was systematically applied to determine optimal SLM parameter combinations (P=120 W, v=500 mm/s, h=45 μm).

summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing (tensile, microhardness) and microstructural characterization (EBSD, TEM) confirmed the strengthening mechanisms including grain boundary strengthening, solid solution strengthening, and precipitation hardening.

summary_en.validation: Numerical examples demonstrate excellent finite-sample performance.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高异种材料接头电化学腐蚀仿真的效率与可靠性。
summary_zh.method: 基于物理有限元模型与机器学习代理模型，结合不确定性量化分析腐蚀行为。

summary_zh.validation: 通过有限元仿真案例验证代理模型预测精度。

summary_en.motivation: To enable efficient statistical corrosion analysis of dissimilar material joints by developing a surrogate model that reduces computational cost of physics-based finite element simulations.
summary_en.method: A physics-based finite element corrosion model incorporating crystal microstructure is coupled with a machine learning surrogate model to perform uncertainty quantification on geometric and environmental factors.

summary_en.result: The method converges with increasing collocation points and preconditioning, achieving competitive memory and training speed compared to other PINN-type frameworks.
summary_en.validation: Validated on three-dimensional elliptic problems with jump conditions across irregular interfaces using numerical benchmarks.

title: HiddenGems: Efficient safety boundary detection with active learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的主动学习方法可用于高效探索设计空间边界，对植入物设计中的约束满足和失效边界检测具有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on safety boundary detection for autonomous driving, not on FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低参数化场景仿真中安全边界检测的计算成本。
summary_zh.method: 提出HiddenGems主动学习方法，通过迭代采样高效识别合规与非合规行为边界。
summary_zh.result: 在自动驾驶场景中，以参数扫描6倍少的仿真次数获得边界估计，并减少86%的仿真用于故障检测。
summary_zh.validation: 在自动驾驶仿真场景（乱穿马路、无保护转弯）中验证边界检测效率。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of safety boundary detection in parameterized simulation scenarios for autonomous systems.
summary_en.method: HiddenGems uses active learning to efficiently map the boundary between compliant and non-compliant behavior by iteratively selecting informative samples.
summary_en.result: The method achieves compliance boundary estimates with 6 times fewer simulations than a parameter sweep and detects failure modes with 86% fewer simulations.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on autonomous driving simulation scenarios including a jaywalker crossing and an unprotected turn.

why_not_core: This paper focuses on magneto-thermal analysis, not on biomechanical implant design or FEA surrogate for structural mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高磁热耦合分析中热点温度预测的精度。
summary_zh.method: 设计以热点位置和温度值为关注点的损失函数，并研究超参数影响。
summary_zh.result: 所提方法显著提升了热点温度的预测准确性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值实验验证，与标准PINN对比。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the accuracy of hot spot temperature prediction in magneto-thermal analysis using physics-informed neural networks.
summary_en.method: A hot spot driven PINN is proposed with a specially designed loss function that treats the hot spot location and temperature as the quantity of interest, and the influence of hyperparameters is investigated.
summary_en.result: The proposed approach significantly improves the accuracy of predicted hot spot temperatures compared to standard PINN.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through numerical experiments on magneto-thermal benchmark problems.

title: Meta Learning of Interface Conditions for Multi-Domain Physics-Informed Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种元学习方法来自动选择多域PINN的界面条件，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模中的多域问题。
why_not_core: No direct application to implant/biomechanics design, no uncertainty quantification for point predictions, and no handling of constraints in optimization.
