summary_en.motivation: The performance of multi-domain PINNs is sensitive to interface conditions, yet no automated selection method exists.
summary_en.method: METALIC employs contextual multi-armed bandit models with Gaussian process rewards to dynamically choose interface conditions for parametric PDEs.
summary_en.result: The method demonstrates advantage on four benchmark PDE families.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on standard PDE families.

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently discover safety boundaries in parameterized scenarios while minimizing expensive simulations.
summary_en.method: HiddenGems uses active learning to iteratively select informative samples and map compliant and non-compliant regions.
summary_en.result: The method achieves compliance boundary estimates with 6 times fewer simulations than a full parameter sweep in an autonomous driving scenario.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on a jaywalker scenario with collision, lane keep, and acceleration metrics, demonstrating sample efficiency.

title: Batch Multi-Fidelity Active Learning with Budget Constraints
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的批量多保真主动学习方法可提高采样效率并考虑预算约束，对用户研究中的昂贵仿真采样问题具有迁移价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant/biomechanics design, lacks uncertainty quantification for point predictions, and does not handle constraints beyond budget.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有单点主动学习效率低，需批量查询以降低成本并提高学习效率。
summary_zh.method: 提出批量多保真主动学习方法，通过互信息度量批量查询多样性，并设计加权贪心算法优化预算约束。
summary_zh.result: 在多个计算物理和工程应用中展示了优于现有方法的性能。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准数值基准和工程案例上验证了方法的有效性。

summary_en.motivation: Single-query multi-fidelity active learning risks correlated samples and low efficiency, motivating a batch approach with budget constraints.
summary_en.method: A batch acquisition function based on mutual information is proposed to penalize correlated queries, optimized by a weighted greedy algorithm achieving near-optimal approximation.
summary_en.result: The method demonstrates improved benefit-cost ratio and learning performance on computational physics and engineering benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks and engineering simulation cases, showing superiority over single-query and random baselines.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究相对密度和应变率对增材制造点阵结构力学行为的影响。
summary_zh.method: 制备不同相对密度的点阵结构，在不同应变率下进行压缩实验。

title: Bayesian Optimization with Conformal Prediction Sets
relevance_to_user: 该论文将共形预测与贝叶斯优化结合，提升了不确定性量化能力，可迁移至植入物设计中的约束优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or multi-objective constrained optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 贝叶斯优化中模型误设和协变量偏移导致预测失效，需保证查询有效性。
summary_zh.method: 提出共形贝叶斯优化，利用共形预测的覆盖保证引导查询到模型有效区域。
summary_zh.result: 在多个黑箱优化任务中，查询覆盖显著提升且样本效率未受损。
summary_zh.validation: 在黑箱优化基准和表格排序任务上数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Bayesian optimization suffers from model misspecification and covariate shift, leading to unreliable predictions.
summary_en.method: We propose conformal Bayesian optimization, which uses conformal prediction coverage guarantees to direct queries to regions where model predictions are valid.
summary_en.result: Query coverage is significantly improved without harming sample efficiency on several black-box optimization tasks.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on black-box optimization and tabular ranking tasks.

title: Targeted active learning for probabilistic models
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过主动学习优化实验设计，可迁移至有限元代理模型的采样效率提升，但未涉及约束处理或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification for implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 设计实验以最大化科学效用，减少不必要的实验次数。
summary_zh.method: 提出PDBAL方法，结合用户指定的风险函数与概率模型，自适应选择实验。
summary_zh.result: 在模拟和药物筛选数据上，PDBAL优于标准主动学习方法，快速收敛到高效用模型。
summary_zh.validation: 通过理论证明和模拟实验验证，并在癌症药物数据上展示效果。

summary_en.motivation: To design experiments that maximize scientific utility by efficiently selecting informative designs.
summary_en.method: PDBAL combines a user-specified risk function with a probabilistic model to adaptively choose experiments with closed-form solutions for exponential family likelihoods.
summary_en.result: PDBAL consistently outperforms untargeted active learning approaches in simulations and rapidly recovers the most efficacious drugs on a cancer drug screen dataset.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical bounds on label complexity are proven, and empirical validation is performed on synthetic benchmarks and a real-world drug screen dataset.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决多层介质稳态热传导正反问题的高效求解。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently solve forward and inverse steady-state heat conduction problems in multilayer media without meshing.
summary_en.method: A multi-domain physics-informed neural network (M-PINN) decomposes the domain into subdomains, each approximated by a fully connected network, and couples them via interface continuity conditions.

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种局部贝叶斯优化方法，可迁移至植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。

summary_en.motivation: Local optimization offers a promising approach to expensive high-dimensional black-box optimization by avoiding global exploration.
summary_en.method: This paper proposes a local Bayesian optimization scheme that maximizes the probability of descent and moves in the direction of most-probable descent, correcting the gradient direction estimate.
summary_en.result: The proposed method outperforms previous local optimization realizations and is competitive with more complicated baselines on synthetic and real-world objectives.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on synthetic functions and real-world objectives with comparisons to multiple baselines.

title: An unsupervised latent/output physics-informed convolutional-LSTM network for solving partial differential equations using peridynamic differential operator
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种无监督的物理信息卷积LSTM网络，用于求解偏微分方程，其方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, contact mechanics, or uncertainty quantification, and lacks experimental validation in a biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高神经网络求解偏微分方程的精度和外推能力。
summary_zh.method: 采用近场动力学微分算子作为卷积滤波器，结合编码器-解码器与ConvLSTM在潜空间和输出空间施加物理约束。

summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准PDE案例验证，与PINN对比。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the accuracy and extrapolation capability of neural network solvers for partial differential equations.
summary_en.method: A novel unsupervised convolutional LSTM network that uses the peridynamic differential operator as a convolutional filter and enforces physics constraints in both latent and output spaces.
summary_en.result: The proposed architecture demonstrates superior training performance and extrapolation ability on several benchmark PDEs compared to standard PINNs.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmark PDE problems with comparison against PINN solvers.

title: Uncertainty Disentanglement with Non-stationary Heteroscedastic Gaussian Processes for Active Learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的非平稳异方差高斯过程能够分离不确定性的类型，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的主动学习采样策略。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to FEA surrogate modeling, lacks constraint handling, and does not address implant or biomechanics design problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 分离高斯过程模型中的偶然不确定性和认知不确定性以提升可解释性。
summary_zh.method: 提出非平稳异方差高斯过程，通过梯度优化学习，并利用认知不确定性指导主动学习。

summary_en.motivation: To improve interpretability of Gaussian processes by disentangling aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty for active learning.
summary_en.method: A non-stationary heteroscedastic Gaussian process model is proposed, trained with gradient-based optimization, and epistemic uncertainty is used to guide active learning queries.
summary_en.result: The model demonstrates improved active learning performance across multiple datasets compared to baselines.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks and ablation studies on standard machine learning datasets.

summary_en.result: The model accurately predicts flowfields and provides well-calibrated confidence intervals, drastically reducing computational time.

title: Credibility assessment of patient-specific computational modeling using patient-specific cardiac modeling as an exemplar

corresponding_authors.name: Pras Pathmanathan
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Center for Devices and Radiological Health, US Food and Drug Administration, Silver Spring, Maryland, United States of America

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了患者特定计算模型的可靠性评估框架，其验证与不确定性量化方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的代理模型评估。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on cardiac electrophysiology models and does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant mechanics, or structural optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 患者特定模型（数字孪生）的可靠性评估方法尚不明确，需要系统框架。
summary_zh.method: 以心脏电生理模型为例，结合ASME V&V40标准，通过多患者验证和不确定性量化分析评估模型可信度。
summary_zh.result: 提出了考虑个体化与非个体化输入不确定性、多患者误差估计等特性的可信度评估流程。
summary_zh.validation: 基于24个患者特定心室模型的虚拟队列进行仿真验证。

summary_en.motivation: The credibility assessment of patient-specific models (PSMs) for healthcare applications lacks a systematic framework, especially for models used in digital twins.
summary_en.method: Using cardiac electrophysiological modeling as an exemplar, the study applies the ASME V&V40 standard and conducts multi-patient verification and uncertainty quantification to evaluate PSM credibility.
summary_en.result: A credibility assessment process is proposed that accounts for inter- and intra-user variability, multi-patient error estimation, and uncertainty in personalized versus non-personalized inputs.
summary_en.validation: Two simulation studies were performed on a virtual cohort of 24 patient-specific ventricular models, including a multi-patient verification and an uncertainty impact analysis.

title: Automated circuit sizing with multi-objective optimization based on differential evolution and Bayesian inference
first_author_affiliation: University ”Politehnica” of Bucharest, Romania

corresponding_authors.name: Cătălin Vișan
corresponding_authors.affiliation: University ”Politehnica” of Bucharest, Romania

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多目标优化方法结合了差分进化与贝叶斯推断，可迁移至植入物设计中的昂贵仿真采样问题。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on analog circuit sizing, not on biomechanical implant design or FEA surrogate modeling for structural mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 模拟电路尺寸设计耗时且需处理多冲突目标。
summary_zh.method: 提出MODEBI方法，结合GDE3与高斯过程代理模型进行多目标优化。
summary_zh.result: 在电压调节器上获得高多样性可行解，且仿真次数显著减少。
summary_zh.validation: 通过两个不同复杂度的电压调节器案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: Manual sizing of analog circuits is time-consuming due to increasing complexity and conflicting objectives.
summary_en.method: MODEBI integrates generalized differential evolution 3 with Gaussian process surrogate models for multi-objective optimization.
summary_en.result: The method achieves highly diverse feasible solutions with significantly fewer simulations than GDE3 or Bayesian optimization.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on two voltage regulators of different complexity levels.

title: Physics Informed Neural Network using Finite Difference Method
venue: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics (SMC)
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于有限差分法的PINN实现，降低了计算成本，但仅测试了拉普拉斯方程和伯格斯方程，未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No FEA surrogate application, no biomedical context, no constraint handling or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低PINN实现成本，避免自动微分复杂性
summary_zh.method: 用有限差分法替代自动微分计算PDE损失函数
summary_zh.result: FDM-PINN在误差和速度上与AD-PINN相当或更优
summary_zh.validation: 在拉普拉斯方程和伯格斯方程上数值验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce implementation complexity and computational cost of physics-informed neural networks by replacing automatic differentiation with finite difference method.
summary_en.method: Proposed a PINN framework that uses finite difference approximations to compute PDE loss functions, inspired by Laplacian filters in image processing.
summary_en.result: The FDM-based PINN achieved comparable accuracy to AD-based PINN while being faster to compute, and outperformed non-PINN deep learning baselines.
summary_en.validation: Validated on Laplace's equation and Burger's equation using numerical benchmarks.

summary_zh.method: 采用激光粉末床熔融技术制造NiTi支架并优化工艺参数
summary_zh.result: 成功制造出具有良好超弹性和径向强度的支架
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学测试和相变分析验证支架性能

summary_en.motivation: To develop a high-performance self-expanding NiTi stent using laser powder bed fusion (LPBF) with optimized process parameters.
summary_en.method: NiTi stents were fabricated by LPBF and characterized for microstructure, phase transformation, and mechanical properties.
summary_en.result: The LPBF-fabricated stents exhibited excellent superelasticity and radial strength comparable to commercial stents.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing (radial compression, fatigue) and differential scanning calorimetry were used to validate performance.

title: A Method for Computing Inverse Parametric PDE Problems with Random-Weight Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于随机神经网络的逆参数PDE求解方法，可迁移至生物力学中的代理模型构建与参数反演。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modelling for implant design, lacks uncertainty quantification, and does not handle constraints or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效求解逆参数偏微分方程问题
summary_zh.method: 采用随机神经网络扩展局部极限学习机至逆问题，提出三种训练算法
summary_zh.result: 无噪声时参数和场解误差指数下降，有噪声时仍保持较高精度
summary_zh.validation: 数值算例验证，与物理信息神经网络对比

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently solve inverse parametric PDE problems by extending randomized neural networks beyond forward problems.
summary_en.method: Three algorithms (NLLSQ, VarPro-F1, VarPro-F2) are developed based on local extreme learning machine and variable projection to train the network for inverse PDEs.
summary_en.result: Exponential error decay with increasing collocation points or network parameters for noise-free data, and robust accuracy for noisy data.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmark examples with comparison to physics-informed neural networks.

title: PropertyDAG: Multi-objective Bayesian optimization of partially ordered, mixed-variable properties for biological sequence design
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种处理部分有序多目标贝叶斯优化的框架，可迁移至植入物设计中的层次化约束优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on biological sequence design and does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant mechanics, or uncertainty quantification for physical simulations.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决生物序列设计中具有层次依赖性的多目标优化问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出PropertyDAG框架，在传统多目标贝叶斯优化上施加目标的部分排序。
summary_zh.result: 在青霉素生产、数值问题和抗体设计任务中验证了有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过模拟主动学习迭代在三个任务上验证。

summary_en.motivation: To address multi-objective optimization with hierarchical dependencies in biological sequence design, where some objectives are conditioned on others.
summary_en.method: PropertyDAG imposes a partial ordering on objectives within multi-objective Bayesian optimization, optimizing each property conditioned on its parent properties satisfying feasibility.
summary_en.result: The framework outperforms standard EHVI on simulated active learning iterations for penicillin production, a toy problem, and antibody design.
summary_en.validation: Validation via simulated active learning on three tasks: penicillin production, toy numerical problem, and real-world antibody design.

summary_en.motivation: To address the uncertainty in bearing capacity prediction of steel tubular members caused by semi-rigid connections in transmission towers.
summary_en.method: A Gaussian process regression surrogate model is developed to predict bearing capacity and quantify prediction uncertainty.
summary_en.result: The GPR model accurately predicts bearing capacity with confidence intervals, outperforming traditional methods.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed using numerical simulation data, demonstrating prediction accuracy and uncertainty quantification capability.

title: Multi-objective and multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization of laser-plasma acceleration
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多目标多保真贝叶斯优化方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的昂贵仿真采样效率问题。

summary_zh.motivation: 加速器束流参数优化中多目标权衡难以高效处理。
summary_zh.method: 提出多目标多保真贝叶斯优化方法，动态选择仿真分辨率。

summary_zh.validation: 在模拟激光等离子体加速器上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Multi-objective optimization in accelerator beam parameter tuning is hindered by the need to iterate over objective weights, leading to inefficiency.
summary_en.method: A multi-objective, multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization method is proposed that dynamically selects simulation resolution and box size to reduce expensive simulations.
summary_en.result: The method achieves comparable performance to single-objective optimization while enabling instant evaluation of new objectives and reducing optimization runtime by an order of magnitude.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a simulated laser-plasma accelerator case.

summary_en.validation: High fusion quality (relative density >99.5%) and mechanical testing confirmed the process optimization.

summary_en.motivation: To reduce computational cost in simulating tire rolling resistance by developing a reduced-order model for viscoelastic internal variables.

why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to implant or biomechanics design, nor does it address surrogate modeling for expensive finite element simulations.

summary_zh.motivation: 避免全系统建模的高成本，实现早期设计中的不确定性量化。

summary_en.motivation: To enable uncertainty quantification early in the design process without expensive full-system modeling by exploiting the modular nature of engineered systems.
summary_en.method: The system is decomposed into a network of interconnected component models that exchange solution information at boundaries, and two iterative uncertainty propagation approaches are implemented in an open-source library.
summary_en.result: The methods are demonstrated on various applications, showing that problem-specific details significantly impact performance and accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through simulation cases across multiple applications, with comparisons to full-system Monte Carlo.

title: Gaussian Process Hydrodynamics

why_not_core: This paper does not address solid mechanics, implant design, or biomechanical FEA; it focuses on fluid dynamics (Euler/Navier-Stokes) with no demonstration on structural or contact problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 用高斯过程替代传统粒子法，实现流体力学的高效概率求解。
summary_zh.method: 将散度自由高斯过程先验置于速度场，通过物理信息核函数融合湍流统计规律。
summary_zh.result: 所需粒子数远少于SPH，且提供不确定性估计，支持数据同化。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值实验对比物理信息核与标准核的精度和稳定性。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a probabilistic Lagrangian method for fluid dynamics that reduces particle count and provides uncertainty estimates.
summary_en.method: A divergence-free Gaussian Process prior is placed on the velocity field, conditioned on vorticity at particle locations, with physics-informed kernels encoding turbulence laws.
summary_en.result: The method requires significantly fewer particles than SPH, yields uncertainty quantification, and enables data assimilation.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on fluid flow benchmarks demonstrate improved accuracy and stability with physics-informed kernels.

title: DeepGraphONet: A Deep Graph Operator Network to Learn and Zero-shot Transfer the Dynamic Response of Networked Systems

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently learn and zero-shot transfer the dynamic response of networked systems with underlying graph structure.
summary_en.method: A Deep Graph Operator Network (DeepGraphONet) that combines Graph Neural Networks for spatial correlation and DeepONet for operator approximation.
summary_en.result: The framework achieves accurate predictions on power grid transient stability and traffic flow forecasting, with resolution independence and zero-shot transfer capability.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on two benchmark dynamical systems (power grid and traffic network).

summary_en.motivation: Stochastic simulators produce random outputs for given inputs, making traditional surrogate models inapplicable and requiring efficient emulation for uncertainty quantification.

summary_en.result: The proposed method accurately represents general response distributions, including bimodal ones, and outperforms the generalized lambda model and kernel density estimator in accuracy.

summary_en.result: P-type TPMS exhibited the highest anisotropy, G-type was near-isotropic, and μLPBF structures demonstrated superior mechanical properties and light-weighting potential compared to conventional LPBF.

why_not_core: This paper does not address implant-specific biomechanics, surrogate model construction for FEA, or multi-objective constrained optimization; it focuses on stochastic Galerkin methods for planar elasticity with multiple uncertain material regions.

summary_zh.result: 方法在计算资源和随机维度离散化方面均高效，期望解和方差可快速计算。

summary_en.motivation: Uncertainty quantification in planar elastic structures with multiple spatially uncertain material parameters suffers from the curse of dimensionality, necessitating efficient computational methods.

summary_en.validation: Numerical results are verified against Monte Carlo and quasi-Monte Carlo methods.

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of time-dependent basis reduced-order models for nonlinear stochastic PDEs to nominal levels without offline preprocessing.

summary_en.result: Orders-of-magnitude speedup demonstrated on 1D stochastic Burgers' equation and 2D compressible Navier-Stokes equations with up to 100 random dimensions.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks against full-order solutions assess accuracy and computational gains.

summary_en.validation: The approach is validated through a numerical simulation case of reactive transport.

summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmark tests.

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the high computational cost of Monte Carlo simulation for uncertainty quantification in nonlinear PDEs.
summary_en.method: Construct data-driven low-fidelity models by coupling reduced-dimension models with discrete empirical interpolation method (DEIM) within a multi-fidelity Monte Carlo framework.

summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on two canonical nonlinear PDEs demonstrate efficiency gains.

summary_en.motivation: To automatically tune the parameters of an AUV's guidance, navigation, and control system for arbitrary high-level objectives under computationally expensive evaluations.

summary_en.result: Energy consumption is reduced by approximately 28% when the maximum allowed path deviation is increased by about 65%.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高物理信息神经网络的可解释性和泛化性能。

summary_en.validation: Validated on standard numerical benchmarks (Kovasznay flow, 2D viscous Burgers) by comparing L2 error and training efficiency against state-of-the-art PINN variants.

why_not_core: This paper does not address constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanical implant design; it focuses on unconstrained single-objective batch Bayesian optimization with multiple acquisition functions.

summary_zh.motivation: 单一采集函数在贝叶斯优化中表现不稳定，需集成多种采集函数提升鲁棒性。

summary_en.motivation: Need for efficient multi-objective optimization of expensive stochastic simulators with high output variance.
summary_en.method: Extend the Pareto Active Learning (PAL) algorithm to the stochastic setting (PALS) using Gaussian process models to account for output uncertainty.

summary_zh.method: 基于损失梯度分配配置点，并优化停滞时重采样重启训练。

summary_en.motivation: Improve PINN training by adaptively selecting collocation points to reduce prediction error and optimization difficulties.

summary_en.result: Achieves up to an order of magnitude lower prediction error than vanilla PINN on 2D Poisson and diffusion-advection systems.

title: Learning the Stress-Strain Fields in Digital Composites using Fourier Neural Operator
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的傅里叶神经算子方法可用于替代昂贵有限元模拟，可迁移至植入物生物力学设计中的应力应变场预测。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constraints or uncertainty quantification, and it is applied to composites rather than implant biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决复合材料微观结构应力应变场高保真预测的计算成本问题。
summary_zh.method: 使用傅里叶神经算子学习微观结构与应力应变场的映射。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the prohibitive computational cost of physics-based solvers for predicting mechanical responses of composite materials with complex microstructures.
summary_en.method: A Fourier neural operator framework is employed to learn the mapping from microstructure geometry to full stress and strain tensor fields.
summary_en.result: The neural operator achieves high-fidelity predictions of stress-strain fields with few training data, zero-shot generalization to unseen geometries, and super-resolution capabilities.
summary_en.validation: Predictions are validated against high-fidelity numerical solutions for various 2D composite microstructures.

title: Deep energy method in topology optimization applications
relevance_to_user: 该方法将物理信息神经网络用于拓扑优化，可迁移至植入物设计优化问题，但未涉及生物力学或实验验证。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on topology optimization using PINNs without addressing implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or experimental validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 将物理信息神经网络应用于拓扑优化，避免单独训练逆问题网络。

summary_en.motivation: To integrate physics-informed neural networks into topology optimization without requiring a separate neural network for the inverse problem.
summary_en.method: The deep energy method solves the forward elasticity problem, and element sensitivities are expressed directly via the displacement field, combined with the method of moving asymptotes for density update.
summary_en.result: Optimized designs from the DEM-based framework are comparable to those from finite element analysis.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks including 2D/3D compliance minimization and metamaterial unit cell design.

title: Noise-aware Physics-informed Machine Learning for Robust PDE Discovery
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的噪声感知物理信息机器学习框架可用于从噪声数据中发现控制方程，其方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型的构建，但未涉及有限元仿真或植入物设计。

summary_zh.motivation: 现有PDE发现方法在噪声数据下效果不佳，需提升鲁棒性。
summary_zh.method: 提出nPIML框架，联合训练求解器和预选器网络，结合稀疏回归与去噪PINNs。
summary_zh.result: 在五个典型PDE上验证了框架的鲁棒性和可解释性。

summary_en.motivation: Existing PDE discovery methods fail under noisy observations, motivating a noise-aware framework for robust identification.
summary_en.method: A noise-aware physics-informed machine learning (nPIML) framework is proposed, jointly training solver and preselector networks with sparse regression and denoising PINNs based on DFT.
summary_en.result: The framework demonstrates robust and interpretable PDE discovery on five canonical PDEs, even under significant noise.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks of canonical PDEs, without experimental or biomechanical application.

relevance_to_user: 该方法使用高斯过程先验和哈密顿蒙特卡洛进行贝叶斯推断，适用于从稀疏噪声数据中学习动力学，可迁移到生物力学代理模型的不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on learning dynamical systems from time-series data, not on surrogate modeling for expensive finite element simulations or implant design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 从部分、噪声、不规则观测中学习非线性动力学的贝叶斯模型发现
summary_zh.method: 结合高斯过程先验、神经常微分方程和哈密顿蒙特卡洛采样进行贝叶斯推断

summary_en.motivation: To develop a Bayesian framework for discovering dynamical system models from partial, noisy, and irregular observations.
summary_en.method: The GP-NODE method combines Gaussian process priors, neural ordinary differential equations, and Hamiltonian Monte Carlo sampling for Bayesian inference with uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.result: The method effectively infers posterior distributions and discovers parsimonious representations in predator-prey, systems biology, and 50-dimensional human motion examples.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on several numerical benchmarks including predator-prey, systems biology, and human motion datasets.

title: Deep Random Vortex Method for Simulation and Inference of Navier-Stokes Equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的深度随机涡方法可加速Navier-Stokes方程的求解与推理，其无网格、可微分的特性有望迁移至生物力学中的有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on fluid dynamics (Navier-Stokes) rather than solid mechanics or implant biomechanics, and lacks validation on biomedical FEA problems or constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有深度Navier-Stokes方法难以处理非光滑或分数阶方程。
summary_zh.method: 提出深度随机涡方法，结合神经网络与随机涡动力学系统，基于蒙特卡洛损失函数训练。
summary_zh.result: 在柯西问题、参数求解和反问题中取得准确结果，尤其在奇异初始条件下优于PINN。
summary_zh.validation: 通过2D和3D不可压缩Navier-Stokes方程的数值基准验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing deep Navier-Stokes informed methods struggle with non-smooth or fractional equations, which are critical in real-world fluid dynamics.
summary_en.method: The Deep Random Vortex Method (DRVM) combines neural networks with a random vortex dynamics system equivalent to the Navier-Stokes equation, using a Monte Carlo-based loss function to avoid auto-differentiation.
summary_en.result: DRVM achieves accurate results for simulation and inference of Navier-Stokes equations, significantly outperforming PINN on cases with singular initial conditions.
summary_en.validation: Validated on Cauchy problems, parametric solver learning, and inverse problems for 2D and 3D incompressible Navier-Stokes equations.

title: Critical Investigation of Failure Modes in Physics-informed Neural Networks

why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究PINN在求解PDE时收敛失败的根本原因。
summary_zh.method: 通过可视化损失景观和参数分布，对比数据驱动与物理驱动损失函数。
summary_zh.result: 边界与域损失尺度不匹配导致高度非凸损失面，易出现梯度消失。
summary_zh.validation: 在两个椭圆问题上进行数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the root causes of convergence failure in physics-informed neural networks for solving PDEs.
summary_en.method: Visualize loss landscapes and parameter distributions, comparing data-driven and physics-informed loss formulations.
summary_en.result: Incomparable scales between boundary and domain loss terms create highly non-convex loss surfaces prone to vanishing gradients.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on two elliptic problems with increasing complexity.

title: Additive Gaussian Processes Revisited
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种可解释的高斯过程模型，其正交加性核可降低维度并提高计算效率，适用于替代建模中的不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or biomechanical implant design; it focuses on kernel design for interpretable GP regression on general datasets.

summary_zh.method: 提出正交加性核（OAK），通过正交约束实现低维可识别表示。

summary_en.motivation: Additive Gaussian processes require high-dimensional interaction terms, limiting interpretability and efficiency.
summary_en.method: The orthogonal additive kernel (OAK) imposes orthogonality constraints on additive functions, enabling a low-dimensional identifiable representation.
summary_en.result: OAK achieves comparable or better predictive performance than black-box models while retaining interpretability.
summary_en.validation: Validated on multiple benchmark regression datasets, showing improved convergence rates and accuracy.

summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks demonstrate efficiency and scalability in high-dimensional optimization.

summary_en.motivation: To enable knowledge transfer between digital twins when physical models are imperfect and individual data are limited.

summary_en.result: Learning between digital twins reduces uncertainty without overconfidence, while ignoring model discrepancy leads to biased and overconfident predictions.
summary_en.validation: Demonstrated on a toy example and a cardiovascular model for hypertension treatment.

summary_en.motivation: To develop a load-path-based method for optimizing lattice structure layout beyond traditional topology optimization.
summary_en.method: U* load path analysis is used to derive stiffness and potential lines, which guide the grading of body-centered cubic unit cell geometries and truss diameters.
summary_en.result: The U*-graded lattice design achieves significantly higher specific stiffness and strength compared to uniform lattice benchmarks.

title: On Learning the Dynamical Response of Nonlinear Control Systems with Deep Operator Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的DeepONet框架可用于学习非线性控制系统的动态响应，其递归预测策略和误差估计方法可迁移至生物力学中植入物长期力学响应的代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, lacks uncertainty quantification, and is not applied to biomedical or implant mechanics problems.

summary_en.motivation: To learn the dynamic response of nonlinear control systems from data without relying on expensive numerical solvers.
summary_en.method: A DeepONet is trained to approximate the local solution operator, then recursively applied with an error-bounded scheme to simulate long-term dynamics.
summary_en.result: The framework accurately predicts responses of predator-prey, pendulum, and cart pole systems.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on three benchmark control systems demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

summary_en.motivation: To improve the accuracy and efficiency of structural damage diagnosis using limited sensor data.

summary_en.result: The proposed method outperforms traditional mixed-input optimization methods on synthetic functions and real-world piezoelectric admittance data.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on synthetic benchmark functions and a real structural damage identification problem using measured admittance data.

summary_en.motivation: To fuse inconsistent field outputs from high- and low-fidelity simulations with incompatible grids or different topologies without additional preprocessing.
summary_en.method: A non-intrusive multi-fidelity reduced-order model is built by projecting solutions onto a common subspace via manifold alignment.
summary_en.result: The multi-fidelity model achieves higher predictive accuracy at lower computational cost compared to a single-fidelity model.
summary_en.validation: Validated on two multi-fidelity scenarios of structural analysis of a benchmark wing geometry.

summary_en.validation: Validated on a powder weighing task, demonstrating constraint handling and efficiency gains.

summary_en.validation: Experimental data from the SDSU cardiac simulator mock-up were used for validation, with Minkowski norm quantifying the discrepancy between simulation and experiment across multiple quantities of interest.

summary_en.result: The approach successfully optimizes segmented thermoelectric legs for maximum efficiency, power, and combined objectives.
summary_en.validation: Optimized candidates are validated by finite element analysis simulations.

title: In Vitro and In Vivo Comparison of Bone Growth Characteristics in Additive-Manufactured Porous Titanium, Nonporous Titanium, and Porous Tantalum Interbody Cages
first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopaedics, School of Medicine, College of Medicine, Taipei Medical University, Taipei 110301, Taiwan

corresponding_authors.name: Yen‐Yao Li
corresponding_authors.affiliation: College of Medicine, Chang Gung University, Taoyuan 333323, Taiwan

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了多孔钛椎间融合器的骨生长特性，涉及孔隙率对细胞迁移和骨整合的影响，但未涉及应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
why_not_core: This paper does not report stress shielding, stiffness matching, fatigue testing, or surface roughness characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较多孔钛、无孔钛和多孔钽椎间融合器的骨生长特性
summary_zh.method: 制备不同孔隙率的多孔钛笼，进行体外细胞实验和猪体内融合模型实验
summary_zh.result: 60%孔隙率多孔钛笼细胞迁移和成骨标志物最高，下沉最小
summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞附着和成骨标志物检测，以及猪体内6个月影像学和组织学评估

summary_en.motivation: To compare bone growth characteristics of additive-manufactured porous titanium, nonporous titanium, and porous tantalum interbody cages.
summary_en.method: Porous titanium cages with varying porosities (20%, 40%, 60%, 80%) were fabricated and evaluated in vitro for cell attachment and osteogenic markers, and in vivo using a pig interbody fusion model.
summary_en.result: The 60% porous titanium cage showed superior cell migration, highest osteogenic marker and ALP activity, and lowest subsidence among all groups.
summary_en.validation: Validation included in vitro cell assays and in vivo radiographic and histological analysis over 6 months in a pig model.

title: Calibration after bootstrap for accurate uncertainty quantification in regression models
first_author_affiliation: Department of Computer Sciences, University of Wisconsin-Madison, Madison, WI, USA

corresponding_authors.name: Glenn Palmer
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Computer Sciences, University of Wisconsin-Madison, Madison, WI, USA

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的bootstrap校准方法可用于提高代理模型的不确定性量化精度，对植入物设计中的可靠预测有参考价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to FEA surrogate modeling or implant biomechanics; it focuses on general regression uncertainty calibration without constraint handling or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 直接bootstrap集成标准差对不确定性的估计不准确，需要校准。
summary_zh.method: 提出一种简单的校准方法，通过缩放因子调整bootstrap方差。
summary_zh.result: 校准后不确定性估计在合成数据和材料科学数据集上显著改善。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成数据和多个材料物理数据集上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Direct bootstrap ensemble standard deviation provides inaccurate uncertainty estimates, necessitating calibration for reliable predictions.
summary_en.method: A simple calibration method is proposed that scales the bootstrap variance to improve uncertainty quantification accuracy.
summary_en.result: The calibrated uncertainty estimates show significant improvement on both synthetic and real materials science datasets.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on synthetic data and multiple physical datasets from materials science.

title: Bayesian Active Learning with Fully Bayesian Gaussian Processes
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过贝叶斯主动学习优化高斯过程超参数，可迁移至生物力学代理模型的主动采样，提高有限元仿真数据效率。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to FEA surrogate modeling, lacks constraint handling, and does not address implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 主动学习中忽略偏差-方差权衡会导致低效查询和多余标注。
summary_zh.method: 提出两种基于全贝叶斯高斯过程的采集函数B-QBC和QB-MGP。
summary_zh.result: B-QBC获得最佳边际似然，QB-MGP获得最佳预测性能。
summary_zh.validation: 在六个模拟器上验证了方法的有效性。

summary_en.motivation: Neglecting the bias-variance trade-off in active learning leads to inefficient querying and unnecessary data labeling.
summary_en.method: Two acquisition functions, B-QBC and QB-MGP, are proposed by approximating the joint posterior of GP hyperparameters.
summary_en.result: B-QBC achieves the best marginal likelihood on average, while QB-MGP achieves the best predictive performance.
summary_en.validation: Empirical validation on six simulators demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed methods.

title: A parametric numerical analysis of femoral stem impaction
first_author_affiliation: Hamburg University of Applied Sciences, Faculty of Life Sciences, Hamburg, Germany

corresponding_authors.name: Nicholas E. Bishop
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Hamburg University of Applied Sciences, Faculty of Life Sciences, Hamburg, Germany

why_not_core: Does not quantify proximal femur stress/strain in Gruen zones, does not report micromotion values, and does not compare intact vs implanted femur.

summary_zh.motivation: 理解股骨柄压配植入过程中冲击参数对植入效果的影响
summary_zh.method: 建立锤/导入器/植入物/骨/软组织的离散化一维模型进行参数分析
summary_zh.result: 减少单次冲击能量并增加次数、增加锤质量等可降低植入所需能量和硬件应力
summary_zh.validation: 仅通过参数化仿真分析，无实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To understand how impaction parameters affect seating and stresses during press-fit femoral stem implantation.
summary_en.method: A uniaxial discretized model of the hammer/introducer/implant/bone/soft-tissues was developed for parametric analysis.
summary_en.result: Reducing energy per hit with more hits, increasing hammer mass, and decreasing introducer mass reduce impaction effort and hardware stresses.
summary_en.validation: The study relies solely on parametric simulation without experimental validation.

title: A high-dimension structural reliability method based on active learning Kriging and dimension reduction technique
venue: Proceedings of the Institution of Mechanical Engineers Part C Journal of Mechanical Engineering Science
first_author_affiliation: Department of Engineering Mechanics, Institute of Aircraft Reliability Engineering, Northwestern Polytechnical University, Xi’an, China

corresponding_authors.name: Changcong Zhou
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Engineering Mechanics, Institute of Aircraft Reliability Engineering, Northwestern Polytechnical University, Xi’an, China

relevance_to_user: 该方法通过主动子空间降维和主动学习Kriging模型解决高维结构可靠性问题，其降维和主动学习策略可迁移至生物力学植入物设计的代理建模中。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, contact mechanics, or patient-specific FEA; it focuses on structural reliability with no biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效估计高维结构失效概率及灵敏度指标。
summary_zh.method: 结合主动子空间降维、主动学习Kriging和蒙特卡洛模拟。
summary_zh.result: 在三个典型算例中验证了方法的有效性和通用性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过线性/非线性、显式/隐式性能函数算例验证。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently and accurately estimate failure probability and sensitivity indices for high-dimensional structures.
summary_en.method: Proposes an AS-AK-MCS method combining active subspace dimension reduction, active learning Kriging, and Monte Carlo simulation.
summary_en.result: Demonstrates effectiveness and versatility on three representative examples including linear/nonlinear and explicit/implicit performance functions.
summary_en.validation: Validated through numerical simulation cases with varying complexity and applied to a composite radome structure.

title: Uncertainty Quantification for Transport in Porous media using Parameterized Physics Informed neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文将参数化PINN应用于多孔介质中的两相流不确定性量化，其方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计的代理建模与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, contact mechanics, or bone-implant interface; it focuses on reservoir engineering (porous media flow) rather than solid mechanics or biomedical FEA.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决多孔介质流动问题中传统随机采样方法计算成本高的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出参数化物理信息神经网络(P-PINN)，将不确定性参数作为网络输入
summary_zh.result: P-PINN能准确匹配集合实现和随机矩，且对输入变化更鲁棒
summary_zh.validation: 通过均质和非均质多孔介质中的Buckley-Leverett问题数值验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of traditional stochastic sampling methods for uncertainty quantification in porous media flow problems.
summary_en.method: A parameterized Physics-Informed Neural Network (P-PINN) is proposed, which treats uncertain reservoir properties as additional input dimensions to the network.
summary_en.result: The P-PINN accurately matches both ensemble realizations and stochastic moments, and exhibits improved robustness to input variations.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on homogeneous and heterogeneous porous media using the Buckley-Leverett two-phase flow problem.

title: Topology Optimized Unit Cells for Laser Powder Bed Fusion
first_author_affiliation: TU Dresden, Dresden, Germany

corresponding_authors.name: Eugen Boos
corresponding_authors.affiliation: TU Dresden, Dresden, Germany

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及LPBF制造和力学测试，但未直接研究应力遮挡或骨整合，对多孔支架设计有参考价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address stress shielding, stiffness matching for biomedical implants, fatigue testing, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 利用增材制造设计具有定制性能的多孔晶格结构单元。
summary_zh.method: 通过生成式设计创建可堆叠单元胞，结合LPBF工艺参数优化与FE模拟。
summary_zh.result: 实验与仿真数据为组合不同单元胞以调控局部性能提供了基础。
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸和压缩实验校准并验证了LPBF工艺及力学FE模型。

summary_en.motivation: To design and characterize structural unit cells as building blocks for porous lattice structures with tailored mechanical properties enabled by additive manufacturing.
summary_en.method: Generative design was used to create stackable unit cells with printability and homogeneous stress distributions, fabricated by LPBF in AlSi10Mg, and validated via tensile and compression tests and FE simulations.
summary_en.result: Experimentally measured properties and process parameters enabled calibration of FE models, providing a basis for combining unit cells into tailored lattices with locally varying properties.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing (tensile and compression) and FE simulation of both the LPBF process and mechanical behavior were used for calibration and validation.

title: Material characterization and bacterial interaction of titanium discs produced by selective laser melting
first_author_affiliation: Department of Medical, Oral and Biotechnological Science, University G. d'Annunzio of Chieti, Via dei Vestini 31, 66013, Italy

corresponding_authors.name: Morena Petrini
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Medical, Oral and Biotechnological Science, University G. d'Annunzio of Chieti, Via dei Vestini 31, 66013, Italy

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了SLM钛盘的表面特性与细菌相互作用，但未涉及应力遮挡、疲劳或骨整合等核心方向。
why_not_core: No stress shielding analysis, no fatigue testing, no osseointegration evaluation, and no porous structure design.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究SLM钛盘表面特性对细菌附着的影响。
summary_zh.method: 制备SLM钛盘，进行表面形貌、粗糙度、润湿性表征及力学测试。
summary_zh.result: SLM钛盘表面粗糙度影响细菌附着，但未评估疲劳性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过SEM、接触角测量和压缩测试验证表面与力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence of surface characteristics of selective laser melted titanium discs on bacterial adhesion.
summary_en.method: Titanium discs were fabricated by SLM and characterized for surface morphology, roughness, wettability, and mechanical properties.
summary_en.result: Surface roughness of SLM titanium discs affected bacterial attachment, but fatigue performance was not assessed.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed via SEM, contact angle measurements, and compression testing.

title: Laser powder bed fusion produced Ti-6Al-4V: Influence of high-energy process parameters on in-situ martensite decomposition and prior beta grain texture
first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanical and Mechatronic Engineering, Stellenbosch University, Joubert street, Stellenbosch 7602, South Africa

corresponding_authors.name: Gerrit Matthys Ter Haar
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical and Mechatronic Engineering, Stellenbosch University, Joubert street, Stellenbosch 7602, South Africa

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了LPBF工艺参数对Ti-6Al-4V微观组织的影响，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或力学性能测试。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on microstructural evolution (martensite decomposition, grain texture) in LPBF Ti-6Al-4V, but does not address porous structures, stress shielding, mechanical testing (static or fatigue), or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究高能LPBF参数对Ti-6Al-4V原位马氏体分解和晶粒织构的影响。
summary_zh.method: 采用不同激光功率和扫描速度进行LPBF实验，并通过EBSD和XRD表征微观组织。
summary_zh.result: 高能量输入促进马氏体分解并形成强织构，影响最终相组成。
summary_zh.validation: 通过微观组织表征验证工艺参数对相变和织构的影响。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of high-energy laser powder bed fusion parameters on in-situ martensite decomposition and prior beta grain texture in Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.method: LPBF experiments were conducted with varying laser power and scan speed, followed by microstructural characterization using EBSD and XRD.
summary_en.result: High energy input promotes martensite decomposition and the formation of strong prior beta grain texture, altering the final phase composition.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through microstructural characterization confirming the influence of process parameters on phase transformation and texture.

title: An investigation of the crashworthiness performance and optimization of tetra-chiral and reentrant crash boxes
venue: Mechanics Based Design of Structures and Machines
first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, TOBB University of Economics and Technology, Ankara, Turkey

corresponding_authors.name: Erdem Acar
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, TOBB University of Economics and Technology, Ankara, Turkey

relevance_to_user: 该论文使用Kriging代理模型和遗传算法对吸能盒进行多目标优化，方法可迁移至植入物设计的代理建模与优化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on crashworthiness of auxetic structures, not on biomedical implant design, stress shielding, or bone-implant interface mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化四手性和内凹型吸能盒的耐撞性能
summary_zh.method: 构建Kriging代理模型并集成遗传算法进行多目标优化
summary_zh.result: 内凹型圆柱吸能盒的比吸能和载荷效率最优
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸试验和FE模型验证，并与试验结果对比

summary_en.motivation: To optimize the crashworthiness of tetra-chiral and reentrant crash boxes for improved energy absorption and load efficiency.
summary_en.method: Kriging surrogate models were built from validated FE simulations and integrated with a genetic algorithm for multi-objective optimization.
summary_en.result: Reentrant cylindrical crash boxes exhibited superior specific energy absorption and crash load efficiency compared to other designs.
summary_en.validation: FE models were validated against tensile tests and crash plate experiments before surrogate construction.

title: Accelerated Training of Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) using Meshless Discretizations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种加速PINN训练的方法，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型，但未涉及约束处理或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address multi-objective constraints, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics-specific applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速物理信息神经网络训练，避免自动微分的高计算成本
summary_zh.method: 用径向基函数有限差分替代自动微分计算空间导数，稀疏矩阵乘法加速
summary_zh.result: 在泊松方程和热方程上实现2-4倍训练加速，精度相当
summary_zh.validation: 通过线性/非线性泊松方程和热方程数值实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate PINN training by replacing expensive automatic differentiation with efficient numerical discretizations.
summary_en.method: Proposes DT-PINNs that use radial basis function-finite differences (RBF-FD) for spatial derivatives, computed via sparse matrix-vector multiplication.
summary_en.result: DT-PINNs achieve 2-4x faster training on consumer GPUs compared to vanilla PINNs with comparable accuracy on Poisson and heat equations.
summary_en.validation: Validated on linear and nonlinear Poisson equations and the heat equation, with accuracy and efficiency comparisons.

title: Revisiting PINNs: Generative Adversarial Physics-informed Neural Networks and Point-weighting Method
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种改进PINN训练效率和精度的生成对抗机制与点加权方法，可迁移至生物力学代理模型构建。
why_not_core: No validation on FEA surrogate tasks, no implant or biomechanics context, no uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决PINN难以利用少量精确解且训练效率低的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出生成对抗PINN（GA-PINN）和自适应点加权方法
summary_zh.result: GA-PINN在多个PDE基准上优于标准PINN，点加权方法提升训练效率
summary_zh.validation: 在多个经典PDE数值实验上验证

summary_en.motivation: To address the limitations of PINNs in exploiting small sets of exact solutions and low training efficiency for complex PDEs.
summary_en.method: Proposes GA-PINN integrating generative adversarial mechanism with PINNs, and a point-weighting method inspired by AdaBoost for adaptive sample weighting.
summary_en.result: GA-PINN outperforms standard PINNs on several well-known PDEs, and the point-weighting method improves training efficiency.
summary_en.validation: Validated through numerical experiments on multiple benchmark PDEs.

title: Likelihood-free inference with deep Gaussian processes
first_author_affiliation: Department of Computer Science, Aalto University, Konemiehentie 2, 02150 Espoo, Finland

corresponding_authors.name: Alexander Aushev
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Computer Science, Aalto University, Konemiehentie 2, 02150 Espoo, Finland

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的深度高斯过程代理模型可用于处理多模态目标分布，有望迁移到生物力学植入物设计中的昂贵仿真采样问题。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on likelihood-free inference for simulator calibration, not on constrained optimization, uncertainty quantification for design, or biomechanical implant applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准高斯过程代理模型在处理多模态目标分布时灵活性不足，限制了贝叶斯优化在似然自由推断中的应用。
summary_zh.method: 提出深度高斯过程作为代理模型，替代标准高斯过程以处理不规则目标分布。
summary_zh.result: 深度高斯过程在多模态分布上优于标准高斯过程，在单模态上性能相当，且所需数据少于神经网络等方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成和真实似然自由推断基准问题上进行数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Standard Gaussian process surrogate models lack flexibility for multimodal target distributions, limiting Bayesian optimization for likelihood-free inference.
summary_en.method: A deep Gaussian process surrogate model is proposed to replace standard GPs, enabling handling of irregularly behaved target distributions.
summary_en.result: DGPs outperform GPs on multimodal objectives and match performance on unimodal cases, while requiring fewer data than neural density and kernel mean embedding alternatives.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on synthetic and real likelihood-free inference benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness.

title: Exact Gaussian Processes for Massive Datasets via Non-Stationary Sparsity-Discovering Kernels
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种精确且稀疏的高斯过程方法，可扩展到大规模数据集，其不确定性量化能力对代理建模具有潜在价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to FEA surrogate modeling or biomechanical design, and lacks validation on engineering simulation problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 精确高斯过程计算成本高，现有近似方法精度有限。
summary_zh.method: 提出非平稳稀疏发现核，利用自然稀疏性实现精确且稀疏的GP。
summary_zh.result: 可扩展至超过500万数据点，保持精确推断。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个大规模数据集上测试，对比近似方法。

summary_en.motivation: Exact Gaussian Processes are computationally prohibitive for large datasets, and existing approximations sacrifice accuracy or flexibility.
summary_en.method: We propose non-stationary, compactly-supported kernels that discover natural sparsity, enabling exact and sparse GP inference.
summary_en.result: The method scales exact GPs to over 5 million data points without approximation.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on large-scale datasets demonstrate scalability and accuracy compared to approximate methods.

title: AVEI-BO: an efficient Bayesian optimization using adaptively varied expected improvement
first_author_affiliation: National Key Laboratory of Science and Technology on Helicopter Transmission, AECC Hunan Aviation Powerplant Research Institute, Zhuzhou, 412002, China

corresponding_authors.name: Cheng Yan
corresponding_authors.affiliation: National Key Laboratory of Science and Technology on Helicopter Transmission, AECC Hunan Aviation Powerplant Research Institute, Zhuzhou, 412002, China

relevance_to_user: 该方法改进了贝叶斯优化的采集函数，可提高代理模型辅助设计的采样效率，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计的具体应用。
why_not_core: No biomedical or implant design context, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification beyond acquisition function.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准EI采集函数在优化后期易陷入局部最优，需改进。

summary_zh.validation: 在数值基准函数和工程优化问题上测试。

summary_en.motivation: Standard expected improvement (EI) acquisition function suffers from local exploitation in later optimization stages, requiring adaptive tuning.
summary_en.method: Proposes adaptively varied expected improvement (AVEI) that dynamically adjusts EI parameters to balance exploration and exploitation.
summary_en.result: AVEI achieves faster convergence than standard EI and several variants on multiple benchmark functions.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmark functions and engineering optimization problems.

title: Mechanical attributes and wave propagation characteristics of TPMS lattice structures
first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Advanced Digital and Additive Manufacturing Center, Main Campus, Khalifa University of Science and Technology, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates

corresponding_authors.name: Wael Zaki
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Advanced Digital and Additive Manufacturing Center, Main Campus, Khalifa University of Science and Technology, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了TPMS点阵结构的力学性能和波传播特性，但未涉及生物医学植入物或应力屏蔽问题。
why_not_core: No biomedical context, no stress shielding or stiffness matching for implants, no LPBF fabrication or fatigue testing.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究TPMS点阵结构的力学性能与波传播特性。
summary_zh.method: 通过数值模拟分析不同TPMS结构的力学响应和波传播。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the mechanical properties and wave propagation characteristics of TPMS lattice structures.

first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Jadavpur University, Kolkata, 700032, India

corresponding_authors.name: Apurba Das
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Aerospace Engineering and Applied Mechanics Department, Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology-Shibpur, Howrah, 711103, India

relevance_to_user: 该论文直接涉及SLM制造多孔钛合金支架，并测试了压缩强度和表面粗糙度，但未研究疲劳和骨整合。
why_not_core: This paper does not evaluate fatigue behavior, osseointegration, or stress shielding; it focuses on static compression, porosity, and surface roughness of SLM-fabricated scaffolds.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM制造多孔钛合金支架的工艺参数对孔隙率和表面粗糙度的影响
summary_zh.method: 设计七种不同结构的Ti-6Al-4V多孔支架(65%孔隙率)，SLM制造并测量孔隙率、表面粗糙度和压缩强度
summary_zh.result: 网格结构表面粗糙度最低，制造精度高；扫描速度影响显微组织
summary_zh.validation: 实验测量孔隙率、表面粗糙度和压缩强度进行验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of SLM process parameters on porosity and surface roughness of Ti-6Al-4V porous scaffolds for orthopedic applications.
summary_en.method: Seven different porous scaffold designs (Diamond, Grid, etc.) with 65% porosity were fabricated via SLM and characterized for porosity, surface roughness, and compressive strength.
summary_en.result: The Grid structure showed the lowest surface roughness and best manufacturing accuracy; scanning speed influenced microstructure.
summary_en.validation: Experimental characterization of porosity, surface roughness, and compressive strength.

title: A-PINN: Auxiliary physics informed neural networks for forward and inverse problems of nonlinear integro-differential equations
first_author_affiliation: Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering, The Hong Kong Polytechnic University, Hung Hom, Kowloon, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

corresponding_authors.name: Yi‐Qing Ni
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering, The Hong Kong Polytechnic University, Hung Hom, Kowloon, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的A-PINN方法可处理积分微分方程，其框架对生物力学中涉及积分约束的代理建模具有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on integro-differential equations without any FEA surrogate, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanics/implant design context.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有PINN求解积分微分方程需离散积分，引入误差。
summary_zh.method: 提出辅助PINN，用辅助输出变量表示积分，通过自动微分替代积分算子。
summary_zh.result: 在多个非线性积分微分方程基准上获得比传统PINN更精确的解。
summary_zh.validation: 通过一维至十维Volterra和Fredholm积分微分方程数值算例验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing PINN methods for integro-differential equations require integral discretization, introducing discretization and truncation errors.
summary_en.method: An auxiliary PINN framework is proposed that defines auxiliary output variables to represent integrals and uses automatic differentiation to replace the integral operator.
summary_en.result: The proposed A-PINN achieves more accurate solutions than conventional PINN on multiple nonlinear integro-differential equation benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on 1D to 10D Volterra and Fredholm integro-differential equations demonstrate the improved accuracy.

title: The microstructure and properties evolution of SS316L fabricated by magnetic field-assisted laser powder bed fusion
first_author_affiliation: School of Mechanical and Automotive Engineering, South China University of Technology, Guangzhou, 510640, China

corresponding_authors.name: Changhui Song
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Mechanical and Automotive Engineering, South China University of Technology, Guangzhou, 510640, China

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究磁场辅助LPBF对SS316L微观结构和性能的影响，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或生物医学植入物相关力学性能。
why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures for stress shielding, fatigue testing, or biomedical implant context; it focuses on magnetic field effects on microstructure and static mechanical properties of SS316L.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索磁场辅助LPBF对SS316L微观结构和性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 在LPBF过程中施加磁场，制备SS316L样品并表征微观结构和力学性能
summary_zh.result: 磁场辅助改善了晶粒细化和力学性能
summary_zh.validation: 通过微观组织观察和拉伸/压缩测试验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of magnetic field assistance during LPBF on the microstructure and mechanical properties of SS316L.
summary_en.method: SS316L samples were fabricated by LPBF with an applied magnetic field, followed by microstructural characterization and mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: Magnetic field assistance led to grain refinement and improved mechanical properties.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through microstructural analysis and tensile/compression tests.

title: Modified AK-MCS method and its application on the reliability analysis of underground structures in the rock mass
venue: Tạp chí Khoa học Công nghệ Xây dựng (KHCNXD) - ĐHXDHN
first_author_affiliation: Faculty of Engineering - Technology, Ha Tinh University, Cam Xuyen district, Ha Tinh province, Vietnam

corresponding_authors.name: Ngoc-Tuyen Tran
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Faculty of Engineering - Technology, Ha Tinh University, Cam Xuyen district, Ha Tinh province, Vietnam

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的改进AK-MCS方法可应用于地下结构可靠性分析，其主动学习策略和Kriging代理模型技术可迁移至生物力学植入物设计的可靠性分析。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or any biomedical context; it focuses on geotechnical tunnel reliability.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高地下结构长期稳定性分析的效率与精度
summary_zh.method: 提出改进的AK-MCS方法，结合新主动学习函数与停止准则
summary_zh.result: 新方法显著减少性能函数调用次数，保持精度
summary_zh.validation: 通过学术算例和深埋隧道算例验证，与MCS及经典Kriging方法对比

summary_en.motivation: To improve the efficiency and accuracy of reliability analysis for long-term stability of underground structures.
summary_en.method: A modified AK-MCS method is proposed with a novel active learning function and stopping criterion to enrich the Kriging surrogate.
summary_en.result: The proposed method significantly reduces the number of performance function calls while maintaining accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Validated on an academic benchmark and a deep tunnel case with viscoelastic Burgers model, compared against direct MCS and classical AK-MCS/EGRA.

title: Identifying Varying Thermal Diffusivity of Inhomogeneous Materials Based on a Hybrid Physics-Informed Neural Network
first_author_affiliation: School of Information Science and Technology, Hainan Normal University, Haikou 570206, P. R. China

corresponding_authors.name: Xiang Li
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Information Science and Technology, Hainan Normal University, Haikou 570206, P. R. China

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的混合PINN方法可用于识别非均匀材料属性，可迁移至生物力学中植入物或骨骼的材料参数反演。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant design, lacks uncertainty quantification, and does not involve biomechanics or structural mechanics constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效识别非均匀材料的热扩散率分布
summary_zh.method: 结合PINN与全连接网络，利用瞬态温度数据反演材料属性
summary_zh.result: 成功识别温度依赖和空间依赖的非均匀热扩散率，对噪声和小数据集鲁棒
summary_zh.validation: 通过二维和三维热传导数值算例验证

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently identify spatially or temperature-dependent thermal diffusivity in inhomogeneous materials using limited temperature measurements.
summary_en.method: A hybrid model combining a physics-informed neural network (PINN) for physics law learning and a fully connected network for property inversion is proposed.
summary_en.result: The model accurately recovers both temperature-dependent and space-dependent thermal diffusivity in 2D and 3D transient heat conduction problems, showing robustness to noise and sparse data.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on synthetic data from forward heat conduction simulations are used to validate the inversion accuracy.

title: High Dimensional Bayesian Optimization with Kernel Principal Component Analysis
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过核主成分分析降维，可迁移至生物力学设计中的高维优化问题，但缺乏不确定性量化和约束处理。
why_not_core: No uncertainty quantification, no constraint handling, and no application to implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决贝叶斯优化在高维问题中采样效率低的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出核主成分分析辅助的贝叶斯优化算法，在非线性低维子流形上构建高斯过程模型
summary_zh.result: 在COCO/BBOB基准测试中，KPCA-BO收敛速度优于标准BO，且维度越高优势越明显
summary_zh.validation: 在标准多模态基准函数上对比验证

summary_en.motivation: Bayesian optimization suffers from poor scalability in high-dimensional problems due to the need for many data points and expensive acquisition optimization.
summary_en.method: This paper proposes KPCA-BO, which embeds a nonlinear low-dimensional submanifold via kernel PCA and performs BO on that submanifold.
summary_en.result: KPCA-BO outperforms vanilla BO in convergence speed on most COCO/BBOB benchmark functions, with greater benefits as dimensionality increases.
summary_en.validation: Validated on the COCO/BBOB multi-modal benchmark suite.

title: Additively manufactured porous titanium alloy scaffolds for orthopaedics: An effect of process parameters on porosity
venue: International Research Journal on Advanced Science Hub
first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Jadavpur University, Kolkata, 700032, India

corresponding_authors.name: Palash Mondal
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Jadavpur University, Kolkata, 700032, India

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及SLM多孔钛支架的制造与压缩测试，但未涉及疲劳、应力遮挡或骨整合等核心方向。
why_not_core: No fatigue testing, stress shielding analysis, surface roughness characterization, or osseointegration assessment.

summary_zh.motivation: 用多孔钛支架替代实体钛，匹配人骨力学性能。
summary_zh.method: 设计不同结构多孔支架，SLM制备并表征孔隙率，进行压缩测试。
summary_zh.result: 孔隙率增加时能量密度、扫描速度提高，激光功率降低，压缩性能良好。
summary_zh.validation: Archimedes法测孔隙率，INSTRON压缩测试验证力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: To replace solid titanium alloys with porous scaffolds to achieve mechanical compatibility with natural bone for orthopedic implants.
summary_en.method: Designed Grid and Vinties scaffolds with 65% porosity, fabricated via SLM, and characterized porosity by Archimedes principle and compressive properties by INSTRON testing.
summary_en.result: Porosity increase correlated with higher energy density, scanning speed, and hatch distance but lower laser power; scaffolds showed good compressive strength for potential orthopedic use.
summary_en.validation: Empirically validated by Archimedes porosity measurement and quasi-static compression testing.

title: SVD Perspectives for Augmenting DeepONet Flexibility and Interpretability
relevance_to_user: 该论文通过SVD增强DeepONet的灵活性和可解释性，其方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型，但未涉及植入物设计或约束优化。
why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics application, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升DeepONet在对称动力学中的表示效率与可解释性
summary_zh.method: 引入SVD分析和预变换网络，提出SVD-DeepONet和flexDeepONet架构
summary_zh.result: flexDeepONet在燃烧化学应用中减少95%参数，准确代理19变量动力学
summary_zh.validation: 通过燃烧化学数值基准测试验证代理精度

summary_en.motivation: To improve the efficiency and interpretability of DeepONet for dynamics with symmetries by leveraging SVD-based low-rank techniques.
summary_en.method: Proposes SVD-DeepONet and flexDeepONet, where a pre-transformation network isolates rigid motions to enable accurate projection onto a low-dimensional basis.
summary_en.result: flexDeepONet achieves accurate surrogates for 19-variable combustion chemistry with 95% fewer trainable parameters than vanilla DeepONet.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks of combustion chemistry dynamics.

title: Physics-Informed Machine Learning for Uncertainty Reduction in Time Response Reconstruction of a Dynamic System
first_author_affiliation: Villanova University, Villanova, PA, USA

corresponding_authors.name: Amirhassan Abbasi
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Villanova University, Villanova, PA, USA

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的物理信息机器学习方法结合了高斯过程的不确定性量化，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的不确定性降低。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or multi-objective constrained optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低动态系统时间响应重构中的预测不确定性
summary_zh.method: 利用高斯过程的不确定性度量，通过对齐模型融合物理模型与数据驱动模型
summary_zh.result: 混合模型显著降低了预测不确定性并提升了性能
summary_zh.validation: 以非线性摆的时间响应重构为案例进行验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce prediction uncertainty in time response reconstruction of dynamic systems by integrating physics-based and data-driven models.
summary_en.method: A hybrid method uses Gaussian process uncertainty to weight contributions from physics-based and data-driven models via an alignment model.
summary_en.result: The hybrid model achieves notable uncertainty reduction and improved performance in reconstructing the nonlinear pendulum's time response.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on a simulated nonlinear pendulum case study.

title: Optimal Data-Generation Strategy for Machine Learning Yield Functions in Anisotropic Plasticity
first_author_affiliation: ICAMS, Ruhr-Universität Bochum, Bochum, Germany

corresponding_authors.name: Ronak Shoghi
corresponding_authors.affiliation: ICAMS, Ruhr-Universität Bochum, Bochum, Germany

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种用于机器学习屈服函数的最优数据生成策略，可迁移至生物力学中替代昂贵有限元模拟的代理模型构建。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on anisotropic plasticity and crystal plasticity data generation, not on implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or patient-specific FEA surrogate modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少晶体塑性有限元生成训练数据的计算成本
summary_zh.method: 研究最优数据生成策略，用最少数据点训练ML屈服函数
summary_zh.result: 300个应力空间数据点即可准确训练各向异性屈服函数
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试，对比不同数据量下的预测精度

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of generating training data from micromechanical models for machine learning yield functions.
summary_en.method: Investigate an optimal data-generation strategy that minimizes the number of data points while maintaining accuracy of the ML yield function.
summary_en.result: 300 stress-space data points are sufficient to train an accurate ML yield function for materials with significant plastic anisotropy.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks comparing prediction accuracy across different training data sizes.

title: Systematic Reliability-Based Multidisciplinary Optimization by Parallel Adaptive Importance Candidate Region
first_author_affiliation: School of Civil Aviation, Northwestern Polytechnical University, Xi’an 710072, China

corresponding_authors.name: Zhiping Yin
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Civil Aviation, Northwestern Polytechnical University, Xi’an 710072, China

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种并行自适应候选区域方法，可提高可靠性优化效率，其方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的昂贵仿真采样问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical implant design, contact mechanics, or patient-specific FEA; it focuses on aerospace RBDO with mathematical and aircraft examples.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统主动学习Kriging方法在可靠性优化中精度提升有限，且无法并行采样。
summary_zh.method: 提出并行自适应候选区域策略，结合改进的SORA方法，同时优化设计和可靠性评估空间。
summary_zh.result: 在数学算例和水陆两栖飞机汲水系统上验证了方法的精度和效率提升。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数学算例和工程案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional active learning Kriging methods suffer from limited accuracy improvement and inability to perform parallel sampling in reliability-based design optimization.
summary_en.method: A parallel adaptive importance candidate region strategy is proposed, integrating a modified sequential optimization and reliability assessment method to simultaneously optimize design and reliability evaluation spaces.
summary_en.result: The method demonstrates improved accuracy and efficiency on mathematical benchmarks and an amphibious aircraft scooping system.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed using numerical benchmarks and an engineering case study.

key_terms.zh: 序列优化与可靠性评估

title: Parametric Dynamic Mode Decomposition for Reduced Order Modeling
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的参数化动态模态分解方法可用于构建参数依赖的降阶模型，有望迁移至生物力学植入物设计的代理模型构建中。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant biomechanics, lacks uncertainty quantification, and validates only on diffusion-dominated problems without biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决参数依赖动态系统的降阶建模问题，提高多查询场景的计算效率。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于DMD特征对插值和Koopman算子插值的两种参数化降阶方法。
summary_zh.result: 在扩散主导的非线性问题中，两种新方法均优于传统堆叠DMD方法。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准算例和辐射传递多物理场算例验证。

summary_en.motivation: To develop efficient parametric reduced-order models for parameter-dependent dynamical systems in multi-query applications.
summary_en.method: Two novel parametric DMD approaches are proposed: one based on interpolation of reduced-order DMD eigenpairs and the other based on interpolation of the reduced Koopman operator.
summary_en.result: Both proposed methods outperform the standard stacked DMD approach on diffusion-dominated nonlinear problems, including a multiphysics radiative transfer example.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks and a multiphysics radiative transfer case study are used for comparison.

title: Improving fatigue performance of metal parts with up-facing inclined surfaces produced by laser powder bed fusion and in-situ laser remelting
first_author_affiliation: KU Leuven, Department of Mechanical Engineering, Member of Flanders Make, Celestijnenlaan 300, Leuven 3001, Belgium

corresponding_authors.name: Brecht Van Hooreweder
corresponding_authors.affiliation: KU Leuven, Department of Mechanical Engineering, Member of Flanders Make, Celestijnenlaan 300, Leuven 3001, Belgium

relevance_to_user: 该论文关注LPBF金属零件的疲劳性能提升，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或生物医学植入物，与用户方向间接相关。
why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, stiffness matching, or biomedical implant context; it focuses on surface quality improvement for general metal parts.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升LPBF金属零件倾斜表面的疲劳性能，减少后处理成本。
summary_zh.method: 采用双激光原位重熔技术，先激光清除粉末再重熔表面。
summary_zh.result: 处理后的试样疲劳寿命显著提高，表面粗糙度和应力集中降低。
summary_zh.validation: 通过三点弯曲疲劳测试对比处理与未处理试样的循环次数。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the fatigue performance of LPBF metal parts with inclined surfaces by reducing surface roughness without post-processing.
summary_en.method: A dual-laser in-situ remelting technique that removes powder from inclined surfaces via laser-induced shock waves and then remelts the exposed surface.
summary_en.result: Treated samples showed significantly increased fatigue life, reduced surface roughness, notch depth, and stress concentration factor.
summary_en.validation: Three-point bending fatigue tests comparing treated and as-built samples of maraging steel and Ti-6Al-4V.

title: Displacement and pressure reconstruction from magnetic resonance elastography images: application to an in silico brain model
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的数据同化与降阶模型方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics design context, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 从部分弹性成像数据重建脑组织位移和压力场
summary_zh.method: 基于参数化背景数据弱方法的降阶数据同化框架
summary_zh.result: 数值实验表明位移和压力联合重建精度高
summary_zh.validation: 使用合成脑模型数据进行验证

summary_en.motivation: To reconstruct tissue displacement and pressure fields from partial magnetic resonance elastography data using a physics-informed data assimilation approach.
summary_en.method: A parametrized-background data weak methodology combined with proper orthogonal decomposition reduced basis is employed to build a physics-informed manifold and solve a minimization problem.
summary_en.result: The framework achieves accurate joint reconstruction of displacement and pressure fields in an in silico brain model.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed using synthetic data from poroelastic simulations of a physiological brain model.

title: Deviations of the SLM Produced Lattice Structures and Their Influence on Mechanical Properties
first_author_affiliation: Institute of Machine and Industrial Design, Faculty of Mechanical Engineering, Brno University of Technology, Technická 2896/2, 616 69 Brno, Czech Republic

corresponding_authors.name: Tomáš Koutecký
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Institute of Machine and Industrial Design, Faculty of Mechanical Engineering, Brno University of Technology, Technická 2896/2, 616 69 Brno, Czech Republic

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了SLM制造多孔结构的支柱偏差及其对力学性能的影响，对生物医用植入物的多孔结构设计具有参考价值。
why_not_core: Does not address biomedical context such as stress shielding or osseointegration, and only static compression testing without fatigue or surface roughness evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: SLM制造多孔结构时支柱几何偏差影响力学性能，需建立统一材料模型。
summary_zh.method: 制造直径0.6-3.0mm的多孔结构，使用μCT分析形状偏差，基于压缩试验建立FEA材料模型。
summary_zh.result: 支柱呈椭圆形，直径越大偏差越小；1.5-3.0mm可用高斯圆柱模型，小直径可用椭圆模型。
summary_zh.validation: 通过压缩试验和μCT数据验证了所提材料模型的适用性。

summary_en.motivation: Shape and dimensional deviations of SLM-produced lattice struts affect mechanical properties, but a universal FEA material model for a wide strut diameter range is lacking.
summary_en.method: Lattice structures with strut diameters from 0.6 to 3.0 mm were SLM-fabricated, digitized by μCT, and analyzed for shape deviations; compression tests were used to develop a FEA material model.
summary_en.result: Strut cross-sections are elliptical, deviations decrease with larger diameters; a Gaussian cylinder model fits diameters 1.5-3.0 mm, while an elliptical model suits smaller diameters.
summary_en.validation: The proposed material model was validated against compression test results and μCT geometric data for the entire diameter range.

title: Multi-material cellular structured orthopedic implants design: In vitro and bio-tribological performance
venue: Journal of the mechanical behavior of biomedical materials/Journal of mechanical behavior of biomedical materials
first_author_affiliation: Center for MicroElectroMechanical Systems (CMEMS-UMinho), University of Minho, Campus de Azurém, 4800-058, Guimarães, Portugal; LABBELS -Associate Laboratory, Braga/Guimarães, Portugal. Electronic address: amafmcosta@gmail.com

corresponding_authors.name: M.M. Costa
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Center for MicroElectroMechanical Systems (CMEMS-UMinho), University of Minho, Campus de Azurém, 4800-058, Guimarães, Portugal; LABBELS -Associate Laboratory, Braga/Guimarães, Portugal. Electronic address: amafmcosta@gmail.com

summary_en.motivation: Standard physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) suffer from limited accuracy, typically achieving only 0.1% relative error.

summary_en.result: CPINNs achieve relative errors four orders of magnitude smaller than the best-performing PINN on a Poisson problem, reaching single-precision accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on Poisson, nonlinear Schrödinger, Burgers', and Allen-Cahn equations demonstrate consistent accuracy improvements.
