corresponding_authors.name: Zhaobo Chen
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Mechatronics Engineering, Harbin Institute of Technology, Harbin, Heilongjiang 150000, China

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了TPMS多孔支架的曲率对力学和传质性能的影响，但未涉及应力遮挡或疲劳性能，且材料为AlSi10Mg而非生物医用钛合金。
why_not_core: This paper does not address stress shielding or fatigue behavior, and uses AlSi10Mg instead of biomedical-grade titanium alloys, lacking direct relevance to hip implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究TPMS多孔支架表面曲率对力学和传质性能的影响机制
summary_zh.method: 采用SLM制备不同曲率的AlSi10Mg支架，结合SEM、FEA和熵权模糊综合评价
summary_zh.result: 曲率分布越集中，支架在相同孔隙率下力学与渗透性能的权衡越好
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验压缩测试和渗透实验验证模拟结果

summary_en.motivation: To investigate how surface curvature of TPMS-based scaffolds influences their mechanical and mass-transport properties for tissue engineering.
summary_en.method: AlSi10Mg scaffolds with varying surface curvatures were fabricated via SLM and characterized using SEM, FEA, and an entropy-weighted fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model.
summary_en.result: Scaffolds with more concentrated curvature distributions exhibited superior trade-offs between compressive modulus and permeability at the same porosity.
summary_en.validation: Experimental compression and permeability tests validated the simulation predictions.

title: Adaptive Model Refinement Approach for Bayesian Uncertainty Quantification in Turbulence Model
first_author_affiliation: Beihang University, 100191 Beijing, People’s Republic of China

corresponding_authors.name: Fanzhi Zeng
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Beihang University, 100191 Beijing, People’s Republic of China

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的自适应模型细化方法可用于贝叶斯不确定性量化，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的代理模型构建。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on turbulence model UQ, not on implant biomechanics, FEA surrogate for stress/strain, or constrained multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 贝叶斯不确定性量化中构建全局精确代理模型计算成本高，限制复杂流动应用。
summary_zh.method: 提出自适应模型细化方法，结合分层采样和继承采样，局部改进高后验密度区域代理模型精度。
summary_zh.result: 相比先验方法，自适应方法用更少评估点获得更可靠推理结果。
summary_zh.validation: 通过二维热源反演问题和高维扩展验证，并应用于跨声速凸包流湍流模型参数UQ。

summary_en.motivation: Bayesian uncertainty quantification in turbulence modeling is computationally expensive due to the need for globally accurate surrogates in high-dimensional spaces.
summary_en.method: An adaptive model refinement approach integrating modified inherited Latin hypercube sampling is proposed to locally improve surrogate accuracy in high-posterior-density regions.
summary_en.result: The adaptive approach yields more reliable inference with fewer evaluation points compared to prior-based methods.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on a 2D heat source inversion problem and a high-dimensional extension, then applied to parametric UQ of the SST turbulence model for transonic bump flow.

title: A comprehensive Bayesian framework for the development, validation and uncertainty quantification of thermal-hydraulic models
first_author_affiliation: Université Paris-Saclay, CEA, Service de Thermohydraulique et de Mécanique des Fluides, 91191 Gif-sur-Yvette, France

corresponding_authors.name: Riccardo Cocci
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Université Paris-Saclay, CEA, Service de Thermohydraulique et de Mécanique des Fluides, 91191 Gif-sur-Yvette, France

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的贝叶斯框架可用于热工水力模型的不确定性量化，其方法论可迁移至生物力学代理模型的验证与UQ。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on thermal-hydraulic models in nuclear engineering, not on FEA surrogate modeling for implant biomechanics or biomedical applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发一个综合贝叶斯框架，用于热工水力模型验证与不确定性量化。
summary_zh.method: 提出贝叶斯方法整合多源数据，量化模型参数与结构不确定性。
summary_zh.result: 框架有效降低了模型预测不确定性，提高了可靠性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过热工水力模拟案例验证框架有效性。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a comprehensive Bayesian framework for systematic validation and uncertainty quantification of thermal-hydraulic models.
summary_en.method: A Bayesian approach integrating multiple data sources to quantify parametric and structural uncertainties in the model.
summary_en.result: The framework reduces predictive uncertainty and enhances model reliability in thermal-hydraulic simulations.
summary_en.validation: Validated through simulation cases in thermal-hydraulic scenarios.

title: Static structural analysis of the effect of change in femoral head sizes used in Total Hip Arthroplasty using finite element method
first_author_affiliation: Manipal Institute of Technology, Manipal Academy of Higher Education

corresponding_authors.name: K N Chethan
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Manipal Institute of Technology, Manipal Academy of Higher Education

relevance_to_user: 该论文使用有限元方法分析了不同股骨头尺寸对全髋关节置换术的影响，但未涉及应力遮挡或微动分析。
why_not_core: This paper does not quantify proximal femur stress shielding in Gruen zones, does not report micromotion with contact modeling, and does not compare intact vs implanted femur.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究不同股骨头尺寸对全髋关节置换术应力分布的影响。
summary_zh.method: 使用Ansys对两种材料组合、不同股骨头尺寸的髋关节假体进行静力结构分析。
summary_zh.result: Ti-6Al-4V股骨柄与CoCr背衬杯、UHMWPE髋臼杯组合在203.48 MPa下应力最小。
summary_zh.validation: 未进行实验验证，仅基于ASTM标准加载条件。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of femoral head size variation on stress distribution in total hip arthroplasty using finite element analysis.
summary_en.method: Static structural analyses were performed in Ansys R-19 for two material combinations (Ti-6Al-4V/CoCr/UHMWPE) with femoral head sizes ranging from 24 mm to 48 mm.
summary_en.result: The combination of Ti-6Al-4V stem, CoCr backing cup, and UHMWPE acetabular cup yielded the lowest von Mises stress of 203.48 MPa.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; loading and boundary conditions followed ASTM standards.

title: Robust and efficient uncertainty quantification for extreme events that deviate significantly from the training dataset using polynomial chaos-kriging
first_author_affiliation: School of Civil and Environmental Engineering, University of Ulsan, South Korea

corresponding_authors.name: Jongho Kim
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Civil and Environmental Engineering, University of Ulsan, South Korea

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多项式混沌克里金方法可处理极端事件的不确定性量化，对生物力学中植入物设计的鲁棒性分析具有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on hydrological extreme events, not on FEA surrogate modeling for implant biomechanics or structural optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决训练数据外极端事件的不确定性量化难题
summary_zh.method: 结合多项式混沌与克里金法构建鲁棒代理模型
summary_zh.result: 在极端事件预测中显著优于传统方法
summary_zh.validation: 通过水文模拟案例验证方法有效性

summary_en.motivation: To achieve robust uncertainty quantification for extreme events that lie outside the training data distribution.
summary_en.method: A polynomial chaos-kriging surrogate model is developed to capture both global trend and local deviations.
summary_en.result: The proposed method demonstrates superior accuracy and robustness in predicting extreme events compared to standard approaches.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on hydrological simulation cases with known extreme event characteristics.

title: Geometry Effect on Microstructure and Mechanical Properties in Laser Powder Bed Fusion of Ti-6Al-4V
first_author_affiliation: Fraunhofer Institute for Laser Technology ILT, Steinbachstraße 15, 52074 Aachen, Germany

corresponding_authors.name: Juri Munk
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Fraunhofer Institute for Laser Technology ILT, Steinbachstraße 15, 52074 Aachen, Germany

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了LPBF Ti-6Al-4V的几何效应与力学性能，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或骨整合，与生物医学植入物方向关联较弱。
why_not_core: This paper does not cover porous structures, stress shielding, stiffness matching, or osseointegration; it focuses on geometry-dependent microstructure and mechanical properties of bulk Ti-6Al-4V.

summary_zh.motivation: 预测复杂几何LPBF零件的局部力学性能以减少实验验证成本。
summary_zh.method: 将代表性几何截面简化为样品，结合热模拟与拉伸/疲劳测试建立相关性模型。
summary_zh.result: 建立了不同几何的极限抗拉强度与温度-时间循环的关联，可推广至零件级预测。
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸和疲劳实验验证了不同几何区域的力学性能差异。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce experimental qualification effort for LPBF parts by predicting local mechanical properties based on geometry-dependent thermal cycles.
summary_en.method: Simplified sample shapes representing geometry sections were fabricated and tested, and a correlation model between ultimate tensile strength and simulated temperature-time cycles was established.
summary_en.result: A correlation between ultimate tensile strength and thermal history was found, enabling part-level property prediction with reduced computational cost.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing (tensile and fatigue) validated the microstructure and property variations across different geometries.

title: Personalized Artificial Tibia Bone Structure Design and Processing Based on Laser Powder Bed Fusion
first_author_affiliation: School of Mechanical Engineering, Hangzhou Dianzi University, Hangzhou 310018, China

corresponding_authors.name: Rougang Zhou
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Mstar Technologies, Inc., Room 406, Building 19, Hangzhou Future Science and Technology City (Haichuang Park), No. 998, Wenyi West Road, Yuhang District, Hangzhou 311121, China

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了个性化胫骨植入物的设计方法，并通过LPBF制造与力学测试实现了刚度匹配，但与用户研究方向相比缺少疲劳测试、表面形貌及骨整合分析。
why_not_core: Does not cover fatigue testing, surface roughness, as-built morphology, or osseointegration assessment.

summary_zh.motivation: 为骨缺损患者设计并制备具有良好力学性能的个性化胫骨植入物。
summary_zh.method: 重建患者损伤模型，设计多孔结构，通过LPBF模拟与实验优化工艺参数并制造。
summary_zh.result: 优化后多孔结构弹性模量约17.88 GPa，与胫骨组织匹配。
summary_zh.validation: 对LPBF制造的多孔结构进行压缩力学测试。

summary_en.motivation: To design and fabricate a personalized tibial implant with biocompatibility and mechanical compatibility for bone defect repair.
summary_en.method: Reconstructed patient-specific tibia model, designed octahedral porous structure, simulated LPBF process parameters, and fabricated via selective laser melting with optimized parameters.
summary_en.result: The optimized porous structure achieved an elastic modulus of 17.88 GPa, closely matching that of natural tibial bone.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical compression tests on the LPBF-fabricated porous structure to measure elastic modulus.

title: Learning cardiac activation maps from 12-lead ECG with multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization on manifolds
relevance_to_user: 该论文将多保真贝叶斯优化应用于心脏激活映射，其方法可迁移至植入物设计中的昂贵仿真替代建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or structural FEA; it focuses on cardiac electrophysiology and ECG inversion.

summary_zh.motivation: 非侵入性定位心脏异位兴奋灶以辅助心律失常治疗。
summary_zh.method: 构建损失函数的高斯过程代理模型，采用多保真贝叶斯优化进行全局寻优。
summary_zh.result: 单保真平均11.7次迭代收敛，多保真仅需3.5次。
summary_zh.validation: 基于模拟心电数据的数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Non-invasive localization of ectopic activation sites in the heart to guide arrhythmia treatment.
summary_en.method: A Gaussian process surrogate of the loss function on the heart surface is built and optimized via multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization with lower confidence bound acquisition.
summary_en.result: Convergence is achieved in 11.7 iterations (single-fidelity) and 3.5 iterations (multi-fidelity) on average.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed using simulated ECG data from a cardiac electrophysiology model.

title: A critical review on the effects of process-induced porosity on the mechanical properties of alloys fabricated by laser powder bed fusion

corresponding_authors.affiliation: Monash Centre for Additive Manufacturing, Monash University, Notting Hill, VIC, 3168, Australia

relevance_to_user: 该综述讨论了LPBF工艺孔隙对力学性能的影响，但未涉及多孔结构设计、应力遮挡或生物医学植入物验证。
why_not_core: This paper is a general review on LPBF porosity effects across multiple alloys, but does not address porous implant design, stress shielding, fatigue testing specific to biomedical implants, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 理解LPBF工艺孔隙对合金力学性能的影响以指导安全设计。
summary_zh.method: 综述了四种常见LPBF合金（Ti-6Al-4V、Inconel 718、316L、AlSi10Mg）的孔隙效应文献。
summary_zh.result: 孔隙显著降低拉伸、疲劳、冲击韧性等性能，但影响程度因合金和孔隙特征而异。
summary_zh.validation: 文献综述，无实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To understand how process-induced porosity affects the mechanical properties of LPBF-fabricated alloys for safe component design.
summary_en.method: This review synthesizes recent literature on the effects of porosity on tensile, fatigue, impact, fracture toughness, creep, and wear behavior of four common LPBF alloys: Ti-6Al-4V, Inconel 718, AISI 316L, and AlSi10Mg.
summary_en.result: Porosity generally degrades mechanical properties, with the extent depending on alloy type, pore characteristics, and loading condition.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; the paper is a literature review.

title: Parsimonious Physics-Informed Random Projection Neural Networks for Initial-Value Problems of ODEs and index-1 DAEs
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的基于随机投影的物理信息神经网络方法可高效求解刚性ODE/DAE，其计算效率与精度优势有望迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模中的参数化仿真加速。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on ODE/DAE solvers without addressing surrogate modeling for expensive finite element simulations, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification in implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效求解刚性ODE和DAE初值问题
summary_zh.method: 单隐层随机投影神经网络，结合牛顿迭代与变步长策略
summary_zh.result: 在多个基准问题上精度优于MATLAB刚性求解器，计算成本相当
summary_zh.validation: 七个基准问题（含DAE、刚性PDE）对比MATLAB求解器

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently solve initial-value problems of stiff ODEs and index-1 DAEs using a parsimonious physics-informed neural network with random projections.
summary_en.method: A single-hidden-layer neural network with fixed random Gaussian kernels and a linear output layer, trained via Newton iterations with Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse or sparse QR, combined with variable step size and continuation methods.
summary_en.result: The proposed scheme outperforms MATLAB stiff solvers (ode23t, ode23s, ode15s) in numerical accuracy on several benchmark problems, especially under high stiffness or sharp gradients, with comparable computational cost.
summary_en.validation: Validated on seven benchmark problems including index-1 DAEs, stiff ODEs, and PDEs (e.g., Allen-Cahn, Kuramoto-Sivashinsky), compared against three MATLAB ODE solvers.

title: Multi-index Sequential Monte Carlo ratio estimators for Bayesian Inverse problems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种多指标序贯蒙特卡洛方法，可高效求解贝叶斯逆问题中的期望估计，其计算效率提升方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant or biomechanics design, nor does it handle constrained optimization or surrogate modeling for FEA; it focuses on Bayesian inverse problems with PDE forward models.

summary_zh.motivation: 贝叶斯逆问题中目标分布期望估计的计算成本高，需高效方法。
summary_zh.method: 提出多指标序贯蒙特卡洛比率估计器，结合多指标蒙特卡洛和序贯蒙特卡洛。
summary_zh.result: 该方法达到MSE^{-1}的规范复杂度，优于单层方法。
summary_zh.validation: 通过椭圆PDE正问题（1D/2D）和对数高斯过程模型验证。

summary_en.motivation: Estimating expectations under a target distribution with unknown normalizing constant and finite-resolution approximation is computationally expensive in Bayesian inverse problems.
summary_en.method: A multi-index Sequential Monte Carlo (MISMC) method is developed to construct ratio estimators that combine the complexity improvements of multi-index Monte Carlo with the inference efficiency of SMC.
summary_en.result: The proposed method provably achieves the canonical complexity of MSE^{-1}, outperforming single-level methods which require MSE^{-ξ} for ξ>1.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on elliptic PDE inverse problems in 1D and 2D, and a log Gaussian process model, demonstrate the complexity gains.

title: Implications of the uncertainty of postoperative functional parameters for the preoperative planning of total hip arthroplasty
first_author_affiliation: Chair of Medical Engineering, Helmholtz‐Institute for Biomedical Engineering RWTH Aachen University  Aachen Germany

corresponding_authors.name: Klaus Radermacher
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Chair of Medical Engineering, Helmholtz‐Institute for Biomedical Engineering RWTH Aachen University  Aachen Germany

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了术后功能参数的不确定性对THA术前规划的影响，其不确定性量化方法可迁移至植入物力学代理模型的鲁棒性设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not develop a surrogate model for FEA, nor does it address implant stress shielding or contact mechanics; it focuses on clinical prediction uncertainty rather than computational efficiency.

summary_zh.motivation: 术后功能参数预测不确定性会显著缩小THA术前规划的目标区域，需量化其影响。
summary_zh.method: 基于196例日本THA患者的预测模型，量化术后站立位骨盆倾斜和单腿站立髋关节力的不确定性。
summary_zh.result: 术后骨盆倾斜不确定性约14°，髋关节力不确定性为17%-37%体重，导致ROM目标区减少43%，载荷目标区减少39%。
summary_zh.validation: 使用临床患者数据验证预测模型的不确定性范围。

summary_en.motivation: The uncertainty in predicting postoperative functional parameters (pelvic tilt and hip joint force) can substantially reduce the feasible target zones for THA planning, yet it has been largely overlooked.
summary_en.method: Prediction models for postoperative standing pelvic tilt and hip joint force during one-leg stance were applied to 196 Japanese THA patients to quantify the reduction in ROM-based and load-based target zones due to prediction uncertainty.
summary_en.result: Prediction uncertainty was approximately 14° for pelvic tilt and 17-37% body weight for hip joint force, leading to a 43% reduction in ROM-based target zone and 39% reduction in load-based target zone, with a combined reduction of 96%.
summary_en.validation: The study used clinical data from 196 THA patients to empirically quantify prediction uncertainties and their impact on target zone reduction.

title: Additive Manufacturing of AlSi10Mg and Ti6Al4V Lightweight Alloys via Laser Powder Bed Fusion: A Review of Heat Treatments Effects

why_not_core: This paper is a review of heat treatments for LPBF alloys, but does not cover porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration relevant to biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 综述LPBF制备的AlSi10Mg和Ti6Al4V合金热处理对性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 系统回顾不同热处理工艺对微观结构和力学性能的影响

summary_en.motivation: Gaussian processes as surrogate models suffer from poor scalability with large observation sets, limiting Bayesian optimization for high-dimensional problems.

summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves state-of-the-art performance on several test functions and two reinforcement-learning problems.

why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanical implant design constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 混合空间优化中变量间复杂交互建模困难。
summary_zh.method: 将变量建模为图节点，用变分图自编码器学习交互并优化。
summary_zh.result: 在合成和真实任务上超越现有方法，计算效率高。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个基准函数和实际问题上进行数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Modeling complex interactions between discrete and continuous variables in mixed-space optimization remains challenging.
summary_en.method: Proposes a graph-based approach where variables are nodes and interactions are edges, using a variational graph autoencoder to learn the graph structure and perform latent space optimization.
summary_en.result: Achieves superior performance and computational efficiency on synthetic and real-world mixed-space optimization tasks compared to existing methods.
summary_en.validation: Validated through numerical benchmarks on synthetic functions and real-world optimization problems.

visual.caption: Figure 1: Comparison of the proposed algorithm with existing approaches. The left figure shows previous approaches of separate modeling for different data types ( Ru et al. 2020 ; Wan et al. 2021 ) whereas the middle figure shows the adoption of additive GP ( Deshwal et al. 2021 ) . Our algorithm conducts graph inference in the given search space and proceeds latent space optimization, thereby preserving a unified search space while also achieving search efficiency.

relevance_to_user: 该综述总结了3D打印多孔Ti6Al4V支架在动物模型中的成骨效果，但未涉及应力遮挡、疲劳性能或表面形貌等核心方向。
why_not_core: This is a systematic review of animal studies on osteogenesis, not a primary study on LPBF fabrication, mechanical testing (fatigue or static), stress shielding, or surface roughness characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估3D打印多孔Ti6Al4V支架在动物长骨缺损模型中的成骨潜力。
summary_zh.method: 系统检索PubMed等数据库，筛选46项动物研究，使用SYRCLE和CAMARADES工具评估偏倚风险。
summary_zh.result: 孔径500-600μm、孔隙率60-70%的十二面体和金刚石孔支架成骨效果最佳。
summary_zh.validation: 基于组织学和micro-CT的动物实验数据汇总，未进行meta分析。

summary_en.motivation: To systematically evaluate the osteogenic potential of 3D-printed porous Ti6Al4V scaffolds for repairing long bone defects in animal models.
summary_en.method: A systematic review of 46 animal studies identified through PubMed, Web of Science, and Embase, with risk of bias assessed using SYRCLE and CAMARADES tools.
summary_en.result: Pore sizes of 500-600 μm and porosities of 60-70% with dodecahedron or diamond pore shapes were associated with optimal osteogenesis.
summary_en.validation: Validation relied on histological and micro-CT outcomes from animal studies; no meta-analysis was performed due to heterogeneity.

title: Uncertainty quantification of a three-dimensional in-stent restenosis model with surrogate modelling

summary_en.motivation: To quantify the impact of uncertain physiological parameters on in-stent restenosis outcomes using surrogate-based uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: A Gaussian process regression surrogate combined with proper orthogonal decomposition was constructed to replace the expensive computational model.
summary_en.result: The two quantities of interest exhibited approximately 11% and 16% uncertainty, with fenestration dominating early-stage uncertainty and blood flow velocity and endothelium regeneration time dominating later stages.
summary_en.validation: The surrogate model was validated by comparing its predictions to the full-order model on simulation cases.

first_author_affiliation: The Biomechanics Group, Department of Mechanical Engineering, Imperial College London, London, UK

corresponding_authors.name: Maxwell J. Munford
corresponding_authors.affiliation: The Biomechanics Group, Department of Mechanical Engineering, Imperial College London, London, UK

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究膝关节植入物对胫骨载荷传递的影响，其方法和结论对髋关节植入物应力遮挡研究具有参考价值。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on knee arthroplasty (tibia) rather than hip implant (femoral stem), and does not quantify stress shielding in Gruen zones or micromotion at the bone-implant interface.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究钛合金多孔结构膝关节假体能否维持胫骨近端自然载荷传递。
summary_zh.method: 在8具新鲜冷冻膝关节标本上进行UKA和TKA手术，比较传统实心假体与钛合金多孔假体的骨界面应力。
summary_zh.result: 钛合金多孔假体恢复了胫骨近端的力学环境，而传统实心假体导致骨表面70%以上区域载荷不足。
summary_zh.validation: 通过尸体标本实验测量骨-植入物界面应力并与天然膝关节对比。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate whether titanium lattice knee implants can preserve native load transfer in the proximal tibia, unlike conventional solid implants that cause stress shielding.
summary_en.method: Cadaveric UKA and TKA procedures were performed on eight fresh-frozen knee specimens using both conventional solid and titanium lattice tibial implants, and bone-implant interface stresses were measured.
summary_en.result: Titanium lattice implants restored the mechanical environment of the native tibia, while conventional solid implants reduced maximum bone stress by a factor of 10 and caused over 70% of bone surface area to be underloaded.
summary_en.validation: Cadaveric experimental measurements of bone-implant interface stress compared with native knee conditions.

summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing including tensile and fatigue experiments was performed on as-built and machined specimens.

summary_en.validation: Damping and mechanical properties were validated by dynamic mechanical analysis (DMA) and quasi-static compression tests.

why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication, no mechanical testing (static or fatigue), no surface roughness or as-built morphology characterization, and no osseointegration assessment.

summary_zh.motivation: 为骨组织工程设计符合皮质骨和松质骨力学要求的TPMS支架。
summary_zh.method: 通过有限元模拟确定TPMS晶格的可设计空间，并基于刚度、孔径和表面积加权筛选。
summary_zh.result: 识别出皮质骨最佳为Schwarz Primitive sheet固体，松质骨最佳为Schoen Gyroid network固体。
summary_zh.validation: 基于文献材料参数进行有限元验证，无实验制造或测试。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a numerical design procedure for TPMS-based lattices that simultaneously satisfy the mechanical and morphological requirements of cortical and trabecular bone.
summary_en.method: The admissible design spaces for twelve TPMS lattice types are first determined by pore size, strut size, and volume fraction, then weighted by Young's modulus, cell size, and surface area using finite element simulations.
summary_en.result: Optimal lattices were identified: Schwarz Primitive sheet solid for cortical bone (67.572 μm pore size, 0.5445 volume fraction, 18.758 GPa modulus) and Schoen Gyroid network solid for trabecular bone (401.39 μm pore size, 0.3 volume fraction, 4.6835 GPa modulus).
summary_en.validation: Validation is based on literature-calibrated material properties and finite element predictions without experimental fabrication or mechanical testing.

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the feasibility of using PINN for solving electro-thermal coupling problems, aiming to overcome mesh dependency of traditional FEM.
summary_en.method: Two neural networks are trained sequentially to approximate the electric field and steady-state thermal field, respectively.
summary_en.result: PINN achieves good accuracy in solving the coupled electro-thermal problem.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed by comparing with FEM numerical solutions.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统欧氏距离模型修正方法不适用于混合不确定性的非精确概率模型。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于Wasserstein距离的核函数构建方法，结合近似贝叶斯推理与切片分割降低计算成本。
summary_zh.result: 可校准高阶超参数，降低模型结构及参数不确定性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过受迫振动钢板和NASA多学科不确定性量化问题验证。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional Euclidean distance-based model updating methods are inadequate for imprecise probabilistic models with mixed uncertainties.
summary_en.method: A Wasserstein distance-based kernel function is proposed, combined with approximate Bayesian computation and slice sampling to reduce computational cost.
summary_en.result: The method calibrates higher-order hyperparameters and reduces both structural and parametric uncertainties.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a forced vibration steel plate problem and a NASA multidisciplinary uncertainty quantification benchmark.

summary_en.validation: The method is validated on five numerical benchmark examples.
